StoryData/P10316.json#0#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#0#content.zh: 听着。你的评判标准有点奇怪，好吗？我们明明是联手干掉它们的，你却要把功劳全揽到自己头上？
StoryData/P10316.json#0#content.en: Look. You've got some weird frame of reference, okay? We took 'em out together with a joint move, and you're taking all the credit for it?

StoryData/P10316.json#1#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#1#content.zh: 无论都市何等辽阔、何等高耸、何等幽深，其每个角落皆知——最后刺穿心脏的战士，方能独享最终的荣耀与功劳！公平即是公平，汝说是吧？
StoryData/P10316.json#1#content.en: 'Tis known in all the corners of the City in all of its vastness, elevation, and depth—the warrior who hath pierced the heart last taketh the final glory and credit! Fair is fair, wouldst thou not say?

StoryData/P10316.json#2#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#2#content.zh: 吾恳请汝思量吾之反驳。回想吾等斩杀第二个敌人之时：纵然吾之长枪已将其四肢与髋部的骨头碾得粉碎、令其痛苦不堪，最后刺穿其咽喉、给予致命一击的，不正是汝吗？
StoryData/P10316.json#2#content.en: I beseech thee to consider this counterpoint mine. Recall our slaying of the second foe: despite my spear pulverizing the bones of its limbs quadruple and hips painful, 'twas thou who had delivered the final blow by piercing its throat, was it not?

StoryData/P10316.json#3#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#4#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#4#content.zh: 汝且继续在记忆中搜寻，便会想起吾将那份荣耀让予了汝；简言之，将荣耀公平公正地归于汝，因为终结其性命的正是汝那一刺！
StoryData/P10316.json#4#content.en: Continue the search within thy recollection, and thou may recall that I deigned to defer that glory mine to thee; in short, 'twas a fair and just accrediting of glory to thee, for thine was the thrust that put an end to its lifebreath!

StoryData/P10316.json#5#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#5#content.zh: ……剩下那些——足足四个——差不多都是我打得只剩一口气，留着让你冲上来收拾的。
StoryData/P10316.json#5#content.en: ... And the rest of them—four, in fact—I pretty much left them hanging by a thread for you to swoop in and finish them off.

StoryData/P10316.json#6#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#7#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#7#content.zh: 可你猜怎么着？我本来打算报告说我们各干掉了2.5个目标。我连想都没想过别的算法，凭什么要想？活儿是我们一起干的，不是吗？
StoryData/P10316.json#7#content.en: But guess what? I was going to report that we took down 2.5 targets each. I didn't even stop to consider the alternative, because why would I? We did the job together, didn't we?

StoryData/P10316.json#8#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#8#content.zh: 结果你现在非要掰扯清楚？你要跟我斤斤计较？
StoryData/P10316.json#8#content.en: And now you wanna insist on picking things apart? You wanna nickel and dime this?

StoryData/P10316.json#9#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#9#content.zh: 恳请汝谨记那句古训：师父施予越多，心便长得越大！
StoryData/P10316.json#9#content.en: Prithee, acquaint thyself with the old maxim that the heart groweth the more its master giveth!

StoryData/P10316.json#10#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#10#content.zh: 是啊，长大。真能长大就好了。拿这短胳膊短腿挥这些武器，到现在还是觉得别扭……
StoryData/P10316.json#10#content.en: Yeah, growing. Wouldn't that be nice. It still feels so weird swinging these weapons with these stubby limbs...

StoryData/P10316.json#11#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#12#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#12#content.zh: 说话注意点，嗯？堂吉诃德。

StoryData/P10316.json#13#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#14#content.zh: 两个孩子各自握着一杆颇为大号的长枪，在湿漉漉的地面上啪嗒啪嗒地跑着。
StoryData/P10316.json#14#content.en: Two children, each wielding a rather sizable spear, were pitter-pattering across the wet floor.

StoryData/P10316.json#15#content.zh:
从高处俯瞰，那景象就像有人把一整桶红漆泼在了生锈的金属板上。
如果红漆氧化后会凝结成暗褐色的话。
StoryData/P10316.json#15#content.en:
From a bird's-eye view, it looked as though someone had spilled a bucketful of red paint over a rusted metal plate.
If red paint could curdle into a dark brown color as it oxidized, that is.

StoryData/P10316.json#16#content.zh: 两人周围躺满了被他们联手刺穿、撕裂的尸体，但那幅景象丝毫引不起两人的兴趣，因为他们正忙着拌嘴、争个不休。
StoryData/P10316.json#16#content.en: The two were surrounded by bodies they skewered and tore through together, but nothing in that sight held an ounce of interest for the two as they were far too busy bickering and arguing with each other.

StoryData/P10316.json#17#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#17#content.zh: *唉*当时我不是跟你讲清楚了吗？还讲得明明白白、有条有理。你必须帮我勾上生长针剂的附加选项，不然我就只能拿到投保时克隆的那副身体……那可是好久以前了。
StoryData/P10316.json#17#content.en: *sigh* Didn't I spell it out for you back then? Clearly and coherently, too. You need to check the box for the growth shots add-on for me or I'll get the same body I had cloned when I signed up for the insurance... Which was a damn while ago.

StoryData/P10316.json#18#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#18#content.zh: 诚然，自那以后汝已提了不下40次……
StoryData/P10316.json#18#content.en: Forsooth, thou hast brought this matter up over 40 times since...

StoryData/P10316.json#19#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#19#content.zh: ……若从那件事算起，今天便是汝第35次折磨吾之耳朵——
StoryData/P10316.json#19#content.en: ... And if we were to count since the incident, today would mark the 35th time thou hast harrowed mine ears with—

StoryData/P10316.json#20#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#20#content.zh: 哦是吗？我在折磨你的耳朵，是吧？
StoryData/P10316.json#20#content.en: Oh yeah? Harrowing your ears, am I?

StoryData/P10316.json#21#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#22#content.zh: ……或许说“拌嘴”还是太客气了；说那些阴阳怪气的牢骚几乎是单方面的，似乎更为公允。
StoryData/P10316.json#22#content.en: ... Perhaps "bickering" is too generous a word; it seems fairer to say that the passive-aggressive bursts of frustration were quite one-sided.

StoryData/P10316.json#23#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#23#content.zh: 我说……我们并肩作战多久了？这种事真的还要翻来覆去地说吗？那条跟在后面的该死寄生虫已经快把我的耐心磨光了，用不着你再来添乱。
StoryData/P10316.json#23#content.en: Man... How long have we been fighting side-by-side now? Do we really need to keep going over stuff like this? That damn leech tagging along is already getting on my last nerve, and I don't need you adding to it.

StoryData/P10316.json#24#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#24#content.zh: 那么，或许汝不必让这桩可怕的保险之事萦绕心头……？
StoryData/P10316.json#24#content.en: Then perchance thou needst not allow this awful talk of insurance to haunt thy mind...?

StoryData/P10316.json#25#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#26#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#27#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#27#content.en: *sigh* Forget it, it's no use crying over spilled milk, anyway.

StoryData/P10316.json#28#content.zh: 发泄完所有怒气后，那孩子泄气地叹了口气，从旁边拖来一张金属凳，一屁股坐了上去。
StoryData/P10316.json#28#content.en: With all the frustration spent, the child let out a defeated sigh and slumped onto a metal stool he dragged from nearby.

StoryData/P10316.json#29#content.zh: 反正事务所代表会到这里和他们会合，所以他并不着急。
StoryData/P10316.json#29#content.en: The Office rep was going to rendezvous with them here anyway, so he wasn't in any rush.

StoryData/P10316.json#30#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#30#content.zh: 我是真跟那家伙合不来，你知道吧……？
StoryData/P10316.json#30#content.en: I really don't gel with that guy, you know...?

StoryData/P10316.json#31#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#31#content.zh: 你看见没，他前一秒还垂头丧气、一副消沉样，下一秒就开始义正辞严地说教了？……我们有骂他吗，有把错全推到他头上吗？没有！我们只是说不想让他进我们事务所，因为他不合适。
StoryData/P10316.json#31#content.en: Did you see him go from moping around, all depressed, to self-righteous moralizing at the drop of a hat? ... Did we tell him off, heaping all the blame on his head? No! All we said was we don't want to accept him at our Office because he won't be a good fit.

StoryData/P10316.json#32#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#32#content.zh: 嗯……确是如此。吾等未曾说谎，却也没把话说得好听点儿，是吧？
StoryData/P10316.json#32#content.en: Hm... 'Tis true, indeed. We spoke no falsehood, but neither did we wrap it in velvet, did we?

StoryData/P10316.json#33#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#33#content.zh: 依吾之见，那年轻人正承受着显而易见的重压！哪怕是最细微的一针，也足以刺破那道众所周知的堤坝，这再自然不过了。
StoryData/P10316.json#33#content.en: I daresay the young man is under quite the palpable pressure! 'Tis only natural that even the teensiest prick would burst the proverbial dam.

StoryData/P10316.json#34#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#34#content.zh: 啊，这倒令吾想起汝当初——*咳咳* 汝莫在意。若再这么想下去，吾恐怕要把自己的脑袋搭进去了。
StoryData/P10316.json#34#content.en: Ah, this bringeth to mind how thou— *cough* Never thou mind. I fear I may be putting my cranium at risk by continuing this line of thought.

StoryData/P10316.json#35#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#35#content.zh: ……你刚才是拿我跟他那种小混混比？
StoryData/P10316.json#35#content.en: ... Did you just compare me to a punk like him?

StoryData/P10316.json#36#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#36#content.zh: 哎呀！万万不可这么想，万万不可。
StoryData/P10316.json#36#content.en: Hoyday! Perish the thought, perish it.

StoryData/P10316.json#37#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#37#content.zh: 随便吧。我只是觉得他那种人不适合干这行。当收尾人。我敢说他一直听到的全是好话，因为都市就是这样。满大街都是战战兢兢的人，生怕一不小心惹到哪个看着不起眼的狠角色。
StoryData/P10316.json#37#content.en: Whatever. I just don't think people like him are built for this line of work. Being a Fixer, I mean. I'm sure he's been hearing nothing but nice things about him, because that's just the way the City is. Full of people trembling in their boots because they might piss off the wrong, unassuming guy in the streets.

StoryData/P10316.json#38#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#38#content.zh: “我绝不会让你这种收尾人进我们事务所。你只会败坏我们的名声、拖我们的后腿。”没错，这话是不好听，但这也是在提醒他去体会话外之音、改进自己，然后——啧，我就是不喜欢他。
StoryData/P10316.json#38#content.en: "I'd never let a Fixer like you join my Office. You'd give us a bad name and trip us up." Sure, it's not a nice thing to say, but it's also an invitation to read between the lines, improve himself, and— Ugh, I just don't like him.

StoryData/P10316.json#39#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#39#content.zh: 啊！吾明白了，小辛克莱。吾看出来了！
StoryData/P10316.json#39#content.en: Ah! I see how it is, young Sinclair. I recognize it!

StoryData/P10316.json#40#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#40#content.zh: 汝口中虽吐出轻蔑之语……肋骨之笼的深处，却跳动着一颗为那年轻人的处境而深深挂怀的心！
StoryData/P10316.json#40#content.en: Though thy tongue speaketh contempt... deeper within the cages of thy ribs beateth a heart most caring for that young man's plight!

StoryData/P10316.json#41#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#41#content.zh: ……你是有什么莫名其妙的需求，非得挨一拳吗？
StoryData/P10316.json#41#content.en: ... Do you have an inexplicable need to get punched in the face?

StoryData/P10316.json#42#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#42#content.zh: 汝此言令吾深感冒犯！吾只是——换言之——嗯，正是。只是想……探一探汝内心深处藏着什么罢了！
StoryData/P10316.json#42#content.en: I take offense to that! I was simply— In other words— Mm, indeed. Merely attempting to... gauge what lieth in the depth of thy person!

StoryData/P10316.json#43#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#43#content.zh: 我都快看见你脑子里的齿轮在转了，就为了编出这么个蹩脚的借口。
StoryData/P10316.json#43#content.en: I could almost see the gears turning in your head to come up with that lame excuse.

StoryData/P10316.json#44#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#45#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#45#content.zh: 无妨；吾恳请汝以都市人的方式思考，也就是说，像个收尾人那样思考。
StoryData/P10316.json#45#content.en: No matter; I beseech thee to think like a Citizen, that is, like a Fixer.

StoryData/P10316.json#46#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#46#content.zh: 吾看不出汝有何理由为他操心，乃至气到这般地步。
StoryData/P10316.json#46#content.en: I see little reason for thee to concern thyself with him until thy temper frayeth so.

StoryData/P10316.json#47#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#47#content.zh: 他不过是个过客罢了，待此番任务了结，便会从吾等眼前与心头消失。只要他不给吾等添麻烦，他是死是活，于吾等都无关紧要、毫无影响。
StoryData/P10316.json#47#content.en: He is but a transient stranger, to be out of our sights and minds once this task is behind us. So long as he bringeth us no grief, it would be of no concern nor consequence to us whether he perisheth or thriveth.

StoryData/P10316.json#48#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#48#content.zh: 而若他真给吾等添了麻烦……嗯，不等吾等任何一人握起长枪，女士便会一枪刺死他。
StoryData/P10316.json#48#content.en: And if he doth bring us grief... Well, the lady shall stab him dead afore either of us even grabeth our spears.

StoryData/P10316.json#49#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#50#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#50#content.zh: 啊，吾如今忆起往昔，那时吾对收尾人唯有盲目的崇拜。吾曾以为收尾人是正义的典范，怀揣着忠义之德……唉，这念头很快便破灭了。
StoryData/P10316.json#50#content.en: Ah, now I reminisce upon my past, in which I harbored naught but blind adoration for the Fixers. I had once believed Fixers to be paragons of justice, armed with the virtue of loyalty... Alas, I was quickly dispelled of that notion.

StoryData/P10316.json#51#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#51#content.zh: 吾从未想过，自己竟也会——如汝所言——为自己那一份斤斤计较。
StoryData/P10316.json#51#content.en: I had never once imagined I would be—as you put it—nickel-and-diming my share.

StoryData/P10316.json#52#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#52#content.zh: ……一切看似高尚之物，不过是一层假面，每一桩正义之举都被放在利润的天平上称量。说到底，没有哪个“专业”的收尾人会被那般情绪化的热忱所驱使。
StoryData/P10316.json#52#content.en: ... All that once seemed noble was but a façade, every act of justice weighed upon the scales of profit margins. In the end, no "professional" Fixer is driven by such emotional fervor.

StoryData/P10316.json#53#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#53#content.zh: 废话。我可不会把后背交给他那种被情绪牵着走的废物。
StoryData/P10316.json#53#content.en: No shit. I'm not trusting an emotion-driven wreck like him to watch my back in a battle.

StoryData/P10316.json#54#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#54#content.zh: 正是。吾自己也深知这一点。
StoryData/P10316.json#54#content.en: Indeed. I know that quite well myself.

StoryData/P10316.json#55#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#55#content.zh: 吾知道，没有什么比只按自认为正义的方式行事更自私了。
StoryData/P10316.json#55#content.en: I know that nothing is more selfish than to act solely in a way one sees as just.

StoryData/P10316.json#56#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#56#content.zh: ……他是被自己的谎言骗进去了，就是这样。他满嘴的说教全是从那儿来的，光用漂亮话包装着。根本不明白自己给身边的所有人造成了多大伤害……
StoryData/P10316.json#56#content.en: ... He's buying into his own deception, that's what. That's where all of his moralizing comes from, wrapped in pretty words alone. He doesn't even understand how much harm he's causing to everyone around...

StoryData/P10316.json#57#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#57#content.en: Hmm hmm, thou speaketh true, indeed...!

StoryData/P10316.json#58#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#58#content.zh: ……等一下。你怎么突然摆出一副高高在上的语气？你现在成什么大师了吗？人生的问题你全都知道答案了，是吧？
StoryData/P10316.json#58#content.en: ... Hold on. What's up with that patronizing tone you've suddenly picked up? Are you some kinda guru now? You know all the answers to life's questions, huh?

StoryData/P10316.json#59#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#59#content.zh: 呜呃……汝真是狡猾，一在道理上落了下风，便从一个话题溜到另一个话题……！
StoryData/P10316.json#59#content.en: Hnngh... Thou'rt a wily one, scurrying from one subject to the next when on an intellectual back foot...!

StoryData/P10316.json#61#content.zh: 这两个孩子的领头人常常坚称，这世上根本没有无私这回事，只有误把自己当作利他的、妄想般的自私。
StoryData/P10316.json#61#content.en: The leader of these two children often insists that there is no such thing as selflessness in this world, only delusional selfishness that mistakes itself for altruism.

StoryData/P10316.json#62#content.zh: 而我也确实认同这一点。
StoryData/P10316.json#62#content.en: And I do agree with that.

StoryData/P10316.json#63#content.zh: 或许那孩子气急败坏的发作之中，正藏着人们通常所说的“无私”。
StoryData/P10316.json#63#content.en: Perhaps that child's irate tantrums house what people commonly term "selflessness."

StoryData/P10316.json#64#content.zh: 那孩子的话听上去或许满是厌烦；他说他宁愿那个“小混混”别再给他的事务所添麻烦……但言语只是掩盖我们意图的层层外衣。在这一切之下，那孩子希望那个年轻人别再走这条自我毁灭的路。在这一切之下，他是在担心那个年轻人。
StoryData/P10316.json#64#content.en: The child's words may have sounded like annoyance; he says that he would prefer the "punk" not to cause his Office further grief... But words are only layers that mask our intent. Beneath it all, the child hopes that the young man will stop going down this self-destructive path. Beneath it all, he is concerned for the young man.

StoryData/P10316.json#65#content.zh: 然而，即便如此，那也终究只是另一种形式的自私——逼着他把心中浮现的想法说出口的自私。
StoryData/P10316.json#65#content.en: Even that, however, must amount to no more than another form of selfishness that demands he give voice to the thoughts that arise in his mind.

StoryData/P10316.json#67#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#68#content.zh: 那孩子从凳子上站起身，掸了掸衣服，迎向远处一个手持长枪的身影，那杆枪和他们的很像。
StoryData/P10316.json#68#content.en: The child rises from the stool, dusting off his clothes to greet a distant figure wielding a spear much like their own.

StoryData/P10316.json#69#content.zh: 紧随其后的是另一个身影，此人穿着灰色夹克，神情同样黯淡而阴沉。
StoryData/P10316.json#69#content.en: Closely following is another figure, this one wearing a gray jacket and an expression just as colorless and grim.

StoryData/P10316.json#70#content.zh: ……宛如复仇与焦虑化成人形，搅成一个漩涡般的深坑。
StoryData/P10316.json#70#content.en: ... Like a swirling pit of vengeance and anxiety personified.

StoryData/P10316.json#71#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#71#content.zh: 遵汝之命，吾等已完成最后一项任务，共计讨伐五名敌人！其中两名由小辛克莱击倒，余下三名则由吾亲手轻松解决。
StoryData/P10316.json#71#content.en: As thou hast commanded, we have completed our final quest, felling a grand total of five foes! Two of which were felled by young Sinclair, and the remaining three vanquished handily by none other than myself.

StoryData/P10316.json#72#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#72#content.zh: 我再说一遍，你的算术到底有什么毛病？！是一人2.5个！
StoryData/P10316.json#72#content.en: Again, what the hell's wrong with your math?! It's 2.5 each!

StoryData/P10316.json#73#content.zh: 你们两个吵个没完，就从来不会累吗？
StoryData/P10316.json#73#content.en: You two don't ever get tired of this squabbling, do you?

StoryData/P10316.json#74#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#74#content.zh: ……喂，谁往你早饭里拉屎了吗？别再板着张脸了行不行？
StoryData/P10316.json#74#content.en: ... Hey, someone shit on your breakfast? Stop frowning already, would you?

StoryData/P10316.json#76#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#76#content.zh: 他还在恢复之中。恳请汝对那孩子手下留情。
StoryData/P10316.json#76#content.en: He recovereth still. Prithee, give the boy quarter.

StoryData/P10316.json#77#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#77#content.zh: 诚然，汝不必又抓住机会转移话题。
StoryData/P10316.json#77#content.en: Forsooth, thou needst not latch onto another opportunity to change the subject.

StoryData/P10316.json#78#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#78#content.en: ... I swear, once we're back in the Office...

StoryData/P10316.json#79#content.zh: 那孩子瞪着另一个孩子，牙齿咬得咯吱作响，但没过多久，他还是决定随着一声深深的、认命的叹息，让所有怒火消散。他看向两个后来者，仿佛在期待着什么。
StoryData/P10316.json#79#content.en: The child glared at the other child, his teeth audibly grinding, but it wasn't long before he decided to let all that anger dissipate through a deep, resigned sigh. He looked at the two latecomers as though he were anticipating something.

StoryData/P10316.json#80#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#80#content.zh: 那么，我们下一个目的地应该是……
StoryData/P10316.json#80#content.en: Well, then our next destination should be...

StoryData/P10316.json#82#content.zh: 大家都打起精神。和往常一样，不管对方是谁……
StoryData/P10316.json#82#content.en: Get your wits about you, everyone. As always, whoever it is...

StoryData/P10316.json#83#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#83#content.en: ... as soon as you get in our way,

StoryData/P10316.json#84#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P10316.json#85#content.zh: 邀请函飘动了片刻，随即如被热浪笼罩般闪烁起来——孩子们被传送到了一个陌生的环境。
StoryData/P10316.json#85#content.en: The Invitation flutters for a moment before shimmering as though it were surrounded by a heat haze—and the children are transported to an unfamiliar environment.

StoryData/P10316.json#86#content.zh: 而对于即将成为某个故事中角色的孩子们，我会说……
StoryData/P10316.json#86#content.en: And to the children who will soon find themselves characters in a tale, I would say...

StoryData/P10316.json#87#content.zh: 啊，对了，当然。那个孩子会说……
StoryData/P10316.json#87#content.en: Ah yes, of course. That child would say...

StoryData/P10316.json#88#content.zh: “正于此地，愿您找到想要的书。”
StoryData/P10316.json#88#content.en: "May you find your book in this place."

StoryData/P11017.json#0#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#0#content.zh: 听着。你的评判标准有点奇怪，好吗？我们明明是联手干掉它们的，你却要把功劳全揽到自己头上？
StoryData/P11017.json#0#content.en: Look. You've got some weird frame of reference, okay? We took 'em out together with a joint move, and you're taking all the credit for it?

StoryData/P11017.json#1#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#1#content.zh: 无论都市何等辽阔、何等高耸、何等幽深，其每个角落皆知——最后刺穿心脏的战士，方能独享最终的荣耀与功劳！公平即是公平，汝说是吧？
StoryData/P11017.json#1#content.en: 'Tis known in all the corners of the City in all of its vastness, elevation, and depth—the warrior who hath pierced the heart last taketh the final glory and credit! Fair is fair, wouldst thou not say?

StoryData/P11017.json#2#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#2#content.zh: 吾恳请汝思量吾之反驳。回想吾等斩杀第二个敌人之时：纵然吾之长枪已将其四肢与髋部的骨头碾得粉碎、令其痛苦不堪，最后刺穿其咽喉、给予致命一击的，不正是汝吗？
StoryData/P11017.json#2#content.en: I beseech thee to consider this counterpoint mine. Recall our slaying of the second foe: despite my spear pulverizing the bones of its limbs quadruple and hips painful, 'twas thou who had delivered the final blow by piercing its throat, was it not?

StoryData/P11017.json#3#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#4#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#4#content.zh: 汝且继续在记忆中搜寻，便会想起吾将那份荣耀让予了汝；简言之，将荣耀公平公正地归于汝，因为终结其性命的正是汝那一刺！
StoryData/P11017.json#4#content.en: Continue the search within thy recollection, and thou may recall that I deigned to defer that glory mine to thee; in short, 'twas a fair and just accrediting of glory to thee, for thine was the thrust that put an end to its lifebreath!

StoryData/P11017.json#5#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#5#content.zh: ……剩下那些——足足四个——差不多都是我打得只剩一口气，留着让你冲上来收拾的。
StoryData/P11017.json#5#content.en: ... And the rest of them—four, in fact—I pretty much left them hanging by a thread for you to swoop in and finish them off.

StoryData/P11017.json#6#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#7#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#7#content.zh: 可你猜怎么着？我本来打算报告说我们各干掉了2.5个目标。我连想都没想过别的算法，凭什么要想？活儿是我们一起干的，不是吗？
StoryData/P11017.json#7#content.en: But guess what? I was going to report that we took down 2.5 targets each. I didn't even stop to consider the alternative, because why would I? We did the job together, didn't we?

StoryData/P11017.json#8#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#8#content.zh: 结果你现在非要掰扯清楚？你要跟我斤斤计较？
StoryData/P11017.json#8#content.en: And now you wanna insist on picking things apart? You wanna nickel and dime this?

StoryData/P11017.json#9#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#9#content.zh: 恳请汝谨记那句古训：师父施予越多，心便长得越大！
StoryData/P11017.json#9#content.en: Prithee, acquaint thyself with the old maxim that the heart groweth the more its master giveth!

StoryData/P11017.json#10#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#10#content.zh: 是啊，长大。真能长大就好了。拿这短胳膊短腿挥这些武器，到现在还是觉得别扭……
StoryData/P11017.json#10#content.en: Yeah, growing. Wouldn't that be nice. It still feels so weird swinging these weapons with these stubby limbs...

StoryData/P11017.json#11#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#12#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#12#content.zh: 说话注意点，嗯？堂吉诃德。

StoryData/P11017.json#13#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#14#content.zh: 两个孩子各自握着一杆颇为大号的长枪，在湿漉漉的地面上啪嗒啪嗒地跑着。
StoryData/P11017.json#14#content.en: Two children, each wielding a rather sizable spear, were pitter-pattering across the wet floor.

StoryData/P11017.json#15#content.zh:
从高处俯瞰，那景象就像有人把一整桶红漆泼在了生锈的金属板上。
如果红漆氧化后会凝结成暗褐色的话。
StoryData/P11017.json#15#content.en:
From a bird's-eye view, it looked as though someone had spilled a bucketful of red paint over a rusted metal plate.
If red paint could curdle into a dark brown color as it oxidized, that is.

StoryData/P11017.json#16#content.zh: 两人周围躺满了被他们联手刺穿、撕裂的尸体，但那幅景象丝毫引不起两人的兴趣，因为他们正忙着拌嘴、争个不休。
StoryData/P11017.json#16#content.en: The two were surrounded by bodies they skewered and tore through together, but nothing in that sight held an ounce of interest for the two as they were far too busy bickering and arguing with each other.

StoryData/P11017.json#17#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#17#content.zh: *唉*当时我不是跟你讲清楚了吗？还讲得明明白白、有条有理。你必须帮我勾上生长针剂的附加选项，不然我就只能拿到投保时克隆的那副身体……那可是好久以前了。
StoryData/P11017.json#17#content.en: *sigh* Didn't I spell it out for you back then? Clearly and coherently, too. You need to check the box for the growth shots add-on for me or I'll get the same body I had cloned when I signed up for the insurance... Which was a damn while ago.

StoryData/P11017.json#18#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#18#content.zh: 诚然，自那以后汝已提了不下40次……
StoryData/P11017.json#18#content.en: Forsooth, thou hast brought this matter up over 40 times since...

StoryData/P11017.json#19#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#19#content.zh: ……若从那件事算起，今天便是汝第35次折磨吾之耳朵——
StoryData/P11017.json#19#content.en: ... And if we were to count since the incident, today would mark the 35th time thou hast harrowed mine ears with—

StoryData/P11017.json#20#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#20#content.zh: 哦是吗？我在折磨你的耳朵，是吧？
StoryData/P11017.json#20#content.en: Oh yeah? Harrowing your ears, am I?

StoryData/P11017.json#21#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#22#content.zh: ……或许说“拌嘴”还是太客气了；说那些阴阳怪气的牢骚几乎是单方面的，似乎更为公允。
StoryData/P11017.json#22#content.en: ... Perhaps "bickering" is too generous a word; it seems fairer to say that the passive-aggressive bursts of frustration were quite one-sided.

StoryData/P11017.json#23#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#23#content.zh: 我说……我们并肩作战多久了？这种事真的还要翻来覆去地说吗？那条跟在后面的该死寄生虫已经快把我的耐心磨光了，用不着你再来添乱。
StoryData/P11017.json#23#content.en: Man... How long have we been fighting side-by-side now? Do we really need to keep going over stuff like this? That damn leech tagging along is already getting on my last nerve, and I don't need you adding to it.

StoryData/P11017.json#24#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#24#content.zh: 那么，或许汝不必让这桩可怕的保险之事萦绕心头……？
StoryData/P11017.json#24#content.en: Then perchance thou needst not allow this awful talk of insurance to haunt thy mind...?

StoryData/P11017.json#25#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#26#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#27#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#27#content.en: *sigh* Forget it, it's no use crying over spilled milk, anyway.

StoryData/P11017.json#28#content.zh: 发泄完所有怒气后，那孩子泄气地叹了口气，从旁边拖来一张金属凳，一屁股坐了上去。
StoryData/P11017.json#28#content.en: With all the frustration spent, the child let out a defeated sigh and slumped onto a metal stool he dragged from nearby.

StoryData/P11017.json#29#content.zh: 反正事务所代表会到这里和他们会合，所以他并不着急。
StoryData/P11017.json#29#content.en: The Office rep was going to rendezvous with them here anyway, so he wasn't in any rush.

StoryData/P11017.json#30#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#30#content.zh: 我是真跟那家伙合不来，你知道吧……？
StoryData/P11017.json#30#content.en: I really don't gel with that guy, you know...?

StoryData/P11017.json#31#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#31#content.zh: 你看见没，他前一秒还垂头丧气、一副消沉样，下一秒就开始义正辞严地说教了？……我们有骂他吗，有把错全推到他头上吗？没有！我们只是说不想让他进我们事务所，因为他不合适。
StoryData/P11017.json#31#content.en: Did you see him go from moping around, all depressed, to self-righteous moralizing at the drop of a hat? ... Did we tell him off, heaping all the blame on his head? No! All we said was we don't want to accept him at our Office because he won't be a good fit.

StoryData/P11017.json#32#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#32#content.zh: 嗯……确是如此。吾等未曾说谎，却也没把话说得好听点儿，是吧？
StoryData/P11017.json#32#content.en: Hm... 'Tis true, indeed. We spoke no falsehood, but neither did we wrap it in velvet, did we?

StoryData/P11017.json#33#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#33#content.zh: 依吾之见，那年轻人正承受着显而易见的重压！哪怕是最细微的一针，也足以刺破那道众所周知的堤坝，这再自然不过了。
StoryData/P11017.json#33#content.en: I daresay the young man is under quite the palpable pressure! 'Tis only natural that even the teensiest prick would burst the proverbial dam.

StoryData/P11017.json#34#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#34#content.zh: 啊，这倒令吾想起汝当初——*咳咳* 汝莫在意。若再这么想下去，吾恐怕要把自己的脑袋搭进去了。
StoryData/P11017.json#34#content.en: Ah, this bringeth to mind how thou— *cough* Never thou mind. I fear I may be putting my cranium at risk by continuing this line of thought.

StoryData/P11017.json#35#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#35#content.zh: ……你刚才是拿我跟他那种小混混比？
StoryData/P11017.json#35#content.en: ... Did you just compare me to a punk like him?

StoryData/P11017.json#36#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#36#content.zh: 哎呀！万万不可这么想，万万不可。
StoryData/P11017.json#36#content.en: Hoyday! Perish the thought, perish it.

StoryData/P11017.json#37#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#37#content.zh: 随便吧。我只是觉得他那种人不适合干这行。当收尾人。我敢说他一直听到的全是好话，因为都市就是这样。满大街都是战战兢兢的人，生怕一不小心惹到哪个看着不起眼的狠角色。
StoryData/P11017.json#37#content.en: Whatever. I just don't think people like him are built for this line of work. Being a Fixer, I mean. I'm sure he's been hearing nothing but nice things about him, because that's just the way the City is. Full of people trembling in their boots because they might piss off the wrong, unassuming guy in the streets.

StoryData/P11017.json#38#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#38#content.zh: “我绝不会让你这种收尾人进我们事务所。你只会败坏我们的名声、拖我们的后腿。”没错，这话是不好听，但这也是在提醒他去体会话外之音、改进自己，然后——啧，我就是不喜欢他。
StoryData/P11017.json#38#content.en: "I'd never let a Fixer like you join my Office. You'd give us a bad name and trip us up." Sure, it's not a nice thing to say, but it's also an invitation to read between the lines, improve himself, and— Ugh, I just don't like him.

StoryData/P11017.json#39#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#39#content.zh: 啊！吾明白了，小辛克莱。吾看出来了！
StoryData/P11017.json#39#content.en: Ah! I see how it is, young Sinclair. I recognize it!

StoryData/P11017.json#40#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#40#content.zh: 汝口中虽吐出轻蔑之语……肋骨之笼的深处，却跳动着一颗为那年轻人的处境而深深挂怀的心！
StoryData/P11017.json#40#content.en: Though thy tongue speaketh contempt... deeper within the cages of thy ribs beateth a heart most caring for that young man's plight!

StoryData/P11017.json#41#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#41#content.zh: ……你是有什么莫名其妙的需求，非得挨一拳吗？
StoryData/P11017.json#41#content.en: ... Do you have an inexplicable need to get punched in the face?

StoryData/P11017.json#42#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#42#content.zh: 汝此言令吾深感冒犯！吾只是——换言之——嗯，正是。只是想……探一探汝内心深处藏着什么罢了！
StoryData/P11017.json#42#content.en: I take offense to that! I was simply— In other words— Mm, indeed. Merely attempting to... gauge what lieth in the depth of thy person!

StoryData/P11017.json#43#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#43#content.zh: 我都快看见你脑子里的齿轮在转了，就为了编出这么个蹩脚的借口。
StoryData/P11017.json#43#content.en: I could almost see the gears turning in your head to come up with that lame excuse.

StoryData/P11017.json#44#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#45#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#45#content.zh: 无妨；吾恳请汝以都市人的方式思考，也就是说，像个收尾人那样思考。
StoryData/P11017.json#45#content.en: No matter; I beseech thee to think like a Citizen, that is, like a Fixer.

StoryData/P11017.json#46#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#46#content.zh: 吾看不出汝有何理由为他操心，乃至气到这般地步。
StoryData/P11017.json#46#content.en: I see little reason for thee to concern thyself with him until thy temper frayeth so.

StoryData/P11017.json#47#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#47#content.zh: 他不过是个过客罢了，待此番任务了结，便会从吾等眼前与心头消失。只要他不给吾等添麻烦，他是死是活，于吾等都无关紧要、毫无影响。
StoryData/P11017.json#47#content.en: He is but a transient stranger, to be out of our sights and minds once this task is behind us. So long as he bringeth us no grief, it would be of no concern nor consequence to us whether he perisheth or thriveth.

StoryData/P11017.json#48#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#48#content.zh: 而若他真给吾等添了麻烦……嗯，不等吾等任何一人握起长枪，女士便会一枪刺死他。
StoryData/P11017.json#48#content.en: And if he doth bring us grief... Well, the lady shall stab him dead afore either of us even grabeth our spears.

StoryData/P11017.json#49#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#50#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#50#content.zh: 啊，吾如今忆起往昔，那时吾对收尾人唯有盲目的崇拜。吾曾以为收尾人是正义的典范，怀揣着忠义之德……唉，这念头很快便破灭了。
StoryData/P11017.json#50#content.en: Ah, now I reminisce upon my past, in which I harbored naught but blind adoration for the Fixers. I had once believed Fixers to be paragons of justice, armed with the virtue of loyalty... Alas, I was quickly dispelled of that notion.

StoryData/P11017.json#51#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#51#content.zh: 吾从未想过，自己竟也会——如汝所言——为自己那一份斤斤计较。
StoryData/P11017.json#51#content.en: I had never once imagined I would be—as you put it—nickel-and-diming my share.

StoryData/P11017.json#52#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#52#content.zh: ……一切看似高尚之物，不过是一层假面，每一桩正义之举都被放在利润的天平上称量。说到底，没有哪个“专业”的收尾人会被那般情绪化的热忱所驱使。
StoryData/P11017.json#52#content.en: ... All that once seemed noble was but a façade, every act of justice weighed upon the scales of profit margins. In the end, no "professional" Fixer is driven by such emotional fervor.

StoryData/P11017.json#53#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#53#content.zh: 废话。我可不会把后背交给他那种被情绪牵着走的废物。
StoryData/P11017.json#53#content.en: No shit. I'm not trusting an emotion-driven wreck like him to watch my back in a battle.

StoryData/P11017.json#54#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#54#content.zh: 正是。吾自己也深知这一点。
StoryData/P11017.json#54#content.en: Indeed. I know that quite well myself.

StoryData/P11017.json#55#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#55#content.zh: 吾知道，没有什么比只按自认为正义的方式行事更自私了。
StoryData/P11017.json#55#content.en: I know that nothing is more selfish than to act solely in a way one sees as just.

StoryData/P11017.json#56#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#56#content.zh: ……他是被自己的谎言骗进去了，就是这样。他满嘴的说教全是从那儿来的，光用漂亮话包装着。根本不明白自己给身边的所有人造成了多大伤害……
StoryData/P11017.json#56#content.en: ... He's buying into his own deception, that's what. That's where all of his moralizing comes from, wrapped in pretty words alone. He doesn't even understand how much harm he's causing to everyone around...

StoryData/P11017.json#57#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#57#content.en: Hmm hmm, thou speaketh true, indeed...!

StoryData/P11017.json#58#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#58#content.zh: ……等一下。你怎么突然摆出一副高高在上的语气？你现在成什么大师了吗？人生的问题你全都知道答案了，是吧？
StoryData/P11017.json#58#content.en: ... Hold on. What's up with that patronizing tone you've suddenly picked up? Are you some kinda guru now? You know all the answers to life's questions, huh?

StoryData/P11017.json#59#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#59#content.zh: 呜呃……汝真是狡猾，一在道理上落了下风，便从一个话题溜到另一个话题……！
StoryData/P11017.json#59#content.en: Hnngh... Thou'rt a wily one, scurrying from one subject to the next when on an intellectual back foot...!

StoryData/P11017.json#61#content.zh: 这两个孩子的领头人常常坚称，这世上根本没有无私这回事，只有误把自己当作利他的、妄想般的自私。
StoryData/P11017.json#61#content.en: The leader of these two children often insists that there is no such thing as selflessness in this world, only delusional selfishness that mistakes itself for altruism.

StoryData/P11017.json#62#content.zh: 而我也确实认同这一点。
StoryData/P11017.json#62#content.en: And I do agree with that.

StoryData/P11017.json#63#content.zh: 或许那孩子气急败坏的发作之中，正藏着人们通常所说的“无私”。
StoryData/P11017.json#63#content.en: Perhaps that child's irate tantrums house what people commonly term "selflessness."

StoryData/P11017.json#64#content.zh: 那孩子的话听上去或许满是厌烦；他说他宁愿那个“小混混”别再给他的事务所添麻烦……但言语只是掩盖我们意图的层层外衣。在这一切之下，那孩子希望那个年轻人别再走这条自我毁灭的路。在这一切之下，他是在担心那个年轻人。
StoryData/P11017.json#64#content.en: The child's words may have sounded like annoyance; he says that he would prefer the "punk" not to cause his Office further grief... But words are only layers that mask our intent. Beneath it all, the child hopes that the young man will stop going down this self-destructive path. Beneath it all, he is concerned for the young man.

StoryData/P11017.json#65#content.zh: 然而，即便如此，那也终究只是另一种形式的自私——逼着他把心中浮现的想法说出口的自私。
StoryData/P11017.json#65#content.en: Even that, however, must amount to no more than another form of selfishness that demands he give voice to the thoughts that arise in his mind.

StoryData/P11017.json#67#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#68#content.zh: 那孩子从凳子上站起身，掸了掸衣服，迎向远处一个手持长枪的身影，那杆枪和他们的很像。
StoryData/P11017.json#68#content.en: The child rises from the stool, dusting off his clothes to greet a distant figure wielding a spear much like their own.

StoryData/P11017.json#69#content.zh: 紧随其后的是另一个身影，此人穿着灰色夹克，神情同样黯淡而阴沉。
StoryData/P11017.json#69#content.en: Closely following is another figure, this one wearing a gray jacket and an expression just as colorless and grim.

StoryData/P11017.json#70#content.zh: ……宛如复仇与焦虑化成人形，搅成一个漩涡般的深坑。
StoryData/P11017.json#70#content.en: ... Like a swirling pit of vengeance and anxiety personified.

StoryData/P11017.json#71#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#71#content.zh: 遵汝之命，吾等已完成最后一项任务，共计讨伐五名敌人！其中两名由小辛克莱击倒，余下三名则由吾亲手轻松解决。
StoryData/P11017.json#71#content.en: As thou hast commanded, we have completed our final quest, felling a grand total of five foes! Two of which were felled by young Sinclair, and the remaining three vanquished handily by none other than myself.

StoryData/P11017.json#72#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#72#content.zh: 我再说一遍，你的算术到底有什么毛病？！是一人2.5个！
StoryData/P11017.json#72#content.en: Again, what the hell's wrong with your math?! It's 2.5 each!

StoryData/P11017.json#73#content.zh: 你们两个吵个没完，就从来不会累吗？
StoryData/P11017.json#73#content.en: You two don't ever get tired of this squabbling, do you?

StoryData/P11017.json#74#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#74#content.zh: ……喂，谁往你早饭里拉屎了吗？别再板着张脸了行不行？
StoryData/P11017.json#74#content.en: ... Hey, someone shit on your breakfast? Stop frowning already, would you?

StoryData/P11017.json#76#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#76#content.zh: 他还在恢复之中。恳请汝对那孩子手下留情。
StoryData/P11017.json#76#content.en: He recovereth still. Prithee, give the boy quarter.

StoryData/P11017.json#77#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#77#content.zh: 诚然，汝不必又抓住机会转移话题。
StoryData/P11017.json#77#content.en: Forsooth, thou needst not latch onto another opportunity to change the subject.

StoryData/P11017.json#78#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#78#content.en: ... I swear, once we're back in the Office...

StoryData/P11017.json#79#content.zh: 那孩子瞪着另一个孩子，牙齿咬得咯吱作响，但没过多久，他还是决定随着一声深深的、认命的叹息，让所有怒火消散。他看向两个后来者，仿佛在期待着什么。
StoryData/P11017.json#79#content.en: The child glared at the other child, his teeth audibly grinding, but it wasn't long before he decided to let all that anger dissipate through a deep, resigned sigh. He looked at the two latecomers as though he were anticipating something.

StoryData/P11017.json#80#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#80#content.zh: 那么，我们下一个目的地应该是……
StoryData/P11017.json#80#content.en: Well, then our next destination should be...

StoryData/P11017.json#82#content.zh: 大家都打起精神。和往常一样，不管对方是谁……
StoryData/P11017.json#82#content.en: Get your wits about you, everyone. As always, whoever it is...

StoryData/P11017.json#83#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#83#content.en: ... as soon as you get in our way,

StoryData/P11017.json#84#title.zh: 楔子事务所 收尾人

StoryData/P11017.json#85#content.zh: 邀请函飘动了片刻，随即如被热浪笼罩般闪烁起来——孩子们被传送到了一个陌生的环境。
StoryData/P11017.json#85#content.en: The Invitation flutters for a moment before shimmering as though it were surrounded by a heat haze—and the children are transported to an unfamiliar environment.

StoryData/P11017.json#86#content.zh: 而对于即将成为某个故事中角色的孩子们，我会说……
StoryData/P11017.json#86#content.en: And to the children who will soon find themselves characters in a tale, I would say...

StoryData/P11017.json#87#content.zh: 啊，对了，当然。那个孩子会说……
StoryData/P11017.json#87#content.en: Ah yes, of course. That child would say...

StoryData/P11017.json#88#content.zh: “正于此地，愿您找到想要的书。”
StoryData/P11017.json#88#content.en: "May you find your book in this place."

StoryData/E100X.json#0#place.zh: 梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

StoryData/E100X.json#2#content.zh: <你还在工作吗？大家早就回房间了。>
StoryData/E100X.json#2#content.en: <Are you still working? Everyone went back to their rooms a while ago.>

StoryData/E100X.json#3#content.en: ... Yes. The backlog is rather substantial.

StoryData/E100X.json#4#content.zh: 浮士德需要补交缺失的3个月份定期报告，还要参加会议，商讨我们在西西弗百货执行任务后引发的……连带事件的善后措施。
StoryData/E100X.json#4#content.en: I am expected to submit 3 months' worth of missing scheduled reports and participate in meetings concerning post-incident measures following the... collateral event in the wake of our mission in the Grand Magasin.

StoryData/E100X.json#5#content.zh: 我们刚从西西弗之塔回来，巴士难得迎来了一段称得上真正休息的时光……
StoryData/E100X.json#5#content.en: We had only just returned from Sisyphe Tower, and for once the bus had finally settled into something resembling genuine downtime...

StoryData/E100X.json#6#content.zh: 但即便大家都回了房间，浮士德仍独自坐在位子上，飞快地敲打着她的设备。
StoryData/E100X.json#6#content.en: But even after everyone had retired to their rooms, Faust remained in her seat, alone, furiously typing away at her device.

StoryData/E100X.json#8#content.zh: 是的。各方渠道都发来了通讯请求。
StoryData/E100X.json#8#content.en: Yes. Various channels have submitted requests for communication.

StoryData/E100X.json#9#content.zh: 就在我们简短交谈的这会儿，她的屏幕上也不断冒出一个个小窗口，接连不断，刚消失就被下一个闪烁的方框取代。
StoryData/E100X.json#9#content.en: Even during our brief exchange, little windows kept blooming endlessly across her screen, only to vanish and be replaced by the next flashing square.

StoryData/E100X.json#10#content.zh: 想想也不奇怪……毕竟我们的任务引发了一连串连锁反应。
StoryData/E100X.json#10#content.en: Guess I shouldn't be too surprised... given the chain reaction of events we set off with our mission.

StoryData/E100X.json#11#content.zh: <……这大概是我们执行完任务后留下的最大烂摊子了吧……？>
StoryData/E100X.json#11#content.en: <... This is probably the biggest mess we've left behind after one of our missions, isn't it...?>

StoryData/E100X.json#12#content.zh: 尽管浮士德认为总部对这样的结果早有准备……
StoryData/E100X.json#12#content.en: While Faust is of the belief that the HQ was prepared for such an outcome...

StoryData/E100X.json#13#content.zh: 我们确实让某个翼的奇点生产线中最重要的设施陷入了瘫痪。从目的论的角度而言。
StoryData/E100X.json#13#content.en: We did cripple the most important facility in a Wing's Singularity production pipeline. Teleologically speaking.

StoryData/E100X.json#14#content.zh: 尽管她的话细想之下相当骇人，浮士德仍平静地继续打着字，语气一如既往地平稳而干巴。
StoryData/E100X.json#14#content.en: Despite the rather horrifying implications of her words, Faust calmly continued typing, her tone as even and dry as ever.

StoryData/E100X.json#15#content.zh: ……反正大概也不是我能帮上忙的事。
StoryData/E100X.json#15#content.en: ... Probably not something I could help with anyway.

StoryData/E100X.json#17#content.zh: 浮士德注意到我还站在她身后，尴尬地挠着时钟脑袋的后脑勺，便停顿了片刻，开口说道。
StoryData/E100X.json#17#content.en: When Faust noticed that I was still standing behind her, awkwardly scratching at the back of my clock head, she paused for a moment before speaking.

StoryData/E100X.json#18#content.en: ... Though one hopes that this is an unwarranted concern...

StoryData/E100X.json#19#content.zh: 您无需担心，但丁。您尚未偏离您的旅途。
StoryData/E100X.json#19#content.en: You need not worry, Dante. You have not yet deviated from your journey.

StoryData/E100X.json#21#content.zh: ……我想，也没必要特地给自己找事操心。
StoryData/E100X.json#21#content.en: ... No need to go out of my way looking for something to worry about, I suppose.

StoryData/E100X.json#22#content.zh: 比起这个，但丁，是不是差不多该开始做准备了？
StoryData/E100X.json#22#content.en: More importantly, Dante, is it about time for us to begin the preparations?

StoryData/E100X.json#24#content.zh: <嗯……我也觉得差不多到时候了……咦，你也开始有这种感觉了吗？>
StoryData/E100X.json#24#content.en: <Uhm... I'm getting a feeling it's about time, yeah... Hey, are you starting to get a feel for it, too?>

StoryData/E100X.json#25#content.zh: 不。浮士德只是想验证一个个人假说：瓦尔普吉斯之夜呈现出某种周期性。
StoryData/E100X.json#25#content.en: No. I merely wish to verify a personal hypothesis that the Walpurgis Nights exhibit a certain periodicity.

StoryData/E100X.json#26#content.zh: <哦对了，霍恩海姆也有过同样的想——>
StoryData/E100X.json#26#content.en: <Oh hey, Hohenheim had the same id—>

StoryData/E100X.json#27#content.zh: 那个男人的“猜测”充斥着荒谬的逻辑跳跃，简直是对统计学本身的侮辱；与之不同，这个理论是由浮士德深奥而具体的演绎推理与思想实验方法推导而出的。
StoryData/E100X.json#27#content.en: Unlike that man's "guess," riddled with ridiculous bounds of logic and insults to the field of statistics itself, this theory is an extrapolation of Faust's esoteric yet concrete deductive reasoning and thought experimentation methodologies.

StoryData/E100X.json#29#content.zh: <不过，你之前不是说过吗，瓦尔普吉斯之夜何时发生完全是由偶然决定的……？>
StoryData/E100X.json#29#content.en: <Still, didn't you say some time ago that only pure chance dictates when Walpurgis Nights will occur...?>

StoryData/E100X.json#30#content.zh: 浮士德至今仍坚持这一判断。不过，浮士德决定采纳这样一种视角：在足够宏观的尺度上，看似纯属偶然的事件最终也会呈现出一定程度的规律性。
StoryData/E100X.json#30#content.en: And I still stand by that assessment. However, I have decided to adopt the perspective that, on a sufficiently macroscopic scale, events that are seemingly of pure chance ultimately exhibit a degree of regularity.

StoryData/E100X.json#31#content.zh: 诚然，若沿着线性的时间轴观察，或许只能将这一事件归结为“纯粹的偶然”。然而，倘若改变观察时间本身的视角……换言之，倘若将上述“轴”加以旋转——
StoryData/E100X.json#31#content.en: Indeed, one may have no choice but to consign the event to "pure chance," observing along a linear temporal axis. However, if the perspective from which time itself is observed were altered... if, in other words, one were to rotate the aforementioned "axis"—

StoryData/E100X.json#32#content.zh: ——浮士德判断，尽管要精确定位那一刻仍有难度，但识别出可以观察到其降临可能性的时段是可行的。
StoryData/E100X.json#32#content.en: —I have judged that, while pinpointing the exact moment is still a challenge, it is possible to identify the period during which its potentiality for advent may be observed.

StoryData/E100X.json#34#content.zh: 看来需要更直白的解释。打个比方，将一组形形色色的情境等同于物质对象“A”，将其周期性的共振等同于“B”；现在假设将“A”投射到一个表面反射系数不均匀的假想镜像上。由此，便可以计算出B的相对——
StoryData/E100X.json#34#content.en: A more straightforward explication is needed, then. Let us say that, for the sake of analogy, a set of variegated scenarios is equated to a material object "A," and the resonance of its periodicity "B"; now suppose we project "A" onto a hypothetical mirror image whose surface has an uneven reflectance coefficient. From that, we may calculate B's relative—

StoryData/E100X.json#37#content.zh: <所以……如果质量为“A”的物质对象基本上就是一堆情境，那就把“A”投射到镜子上，再用周期共振“B”来算出数值。我理解得对吗？>
StoryData/E100X.json#37#content.en: <So... if a material object with mass "A" is basically a bunch of scenarios, you project "A" onto a mirror and use the cycle resonance "B" to calculate the value. Did I get that right?>

StoryData/E100X.json#40#content.zh: 仅仅是把浮士德说过的话换个说法复述一遍，并不能证明您真的理解了内容。
StoryData/E100X.json#40#content.en: Simply rephrasing what Faust has said back to me does not lend any credence to the supposed notion that you truly understood the material.

StoryData/E100X.json#41#content.zh: ……早知道至少该翻翻同义词词典的。
StoryData/E100X.json#41#content.en: ... Maybe I should've at least flipped through a thesaurus.

StoryData/E100X.json#42#content.zh: <我说，我这不是在努力理解你说的话嘛……？>
StoryData/E100X.json#42#content.en: <Look, I'm just trying to understand what you're saying, okay...?>

StoryData/E100X.json#43#content.zh: 简单来说，这是根据以往历次瓦尔普吉斯之夜收集的数据所做的归纳推断。
StoryData/E100X.json#43#content.en: Simply put, it is an inductive inference extrapolated from the data gathered over previous Walpurgis Nights.

StoryData/E100X.json#44#content.zh: <那照这个推断，你觉得它会在什么时候发生？>
StoryData/E100X.json#44#content.en: <Then based on that reasoning, when do you think it'll happen?>

StoryData/E100X.json#45#content.zh: 按浮士德的计算，它本该在大约一小时前发生，看来浮士德的计算得出了不准确的预测。这也是浮士德选择留在这里继续工作、而不回房间的原因之一。
StoryData/E100X.json#45#content.en: It should have occurred approximately an hour ago based on my calculations, which now appear to have led me to an inaccurate prediction. It was one of the reasons I have elected to continue working out here instead of returning to my room.

StoryData/E100X.json#46#content.zh: 不过，但丁，既然您的直觉也认为那一夜即将来临，这便支持了浮士德的误差极小这一可能性。一旦将这一轮瓦尔普吉斯之夜纳入数据集——
StoryData/E100X.json#46#content.en: However, the fact that your intuition also places the coming of the Night close at hand, Dante, lends support to the possibility that my margin of error is minuscule. Once this round of Walpurgis Night is added to the data set—

StoryData/E100X.json#48#content.zh: ——该假说成立的可能性将提升0.552%。
StoryData/E100X.json#48#content.en: —it will increase the likelihood of this hypothesis proving true by 0.552%.

StoryData/E100X.json#49#content.en: <Huh, not as much as I expected.>

StoryData/E100X.json#50#content.zh: 无论多么微小，这都足以证明浮士德的方法正朝着有利的方向前进。毕竟，看着一个假说逐渐成熟为理论的过程，总是相当令人愉快。
StoryData/E100X.json#50#content.en: It is sufficient evidence that my approach is moving in a favorable direction, no matter how incremental it may be. After all, the process by which a hypothesis gradually matures into a theory is always quite enjoyable.

StoryData/E100X.json#51#content.en: Well, then... Take the lead, Dante.

StoryData/E100X.json#52#content.zh: ……她说的话，我大半还是没听懂……
StoryData/E100X.json#52#content.en: ... Most of her words still sailed clean over my head...

StoryData/E100X.json#53#content.zh: ……但我相信，只要像往常一样把情境走到最后，自然就会明白。
StoryData/E100X.json#53#content.en: ... but I'm sure I'll find out as we go along, following the scenario to the end as we've always done.

StoryData/E100X.json#54#content.zh: 哇，这个地方……和我们之前去过的地方看起来好不一样呀！
StoryData/E100X.json#54#content.en: Whoa, this place looks... so distinct from what we'd seen on our previous excursions!

StoryData/E100X.json#55#content.zh: 地面结构由吸音板构成……而内部通道是为高效通行而设计，使区域与走廊之间的往来畅通无阻……
StoryData/E100X.json#55#content.en: The floor construction consists of sound-absorbing panels... And the interior paths are designed for efficient transportation, enabling unimpeded traffic between the bays and the hallways...

StoryData/E100X.json#56#content.zh: 哦，看来建筑师选用了挑高结构，以最有效地消散声波，而环境灯的布置则显示出一种格外注重减轻眼部疲劳的设计理念。
StoryData/E100X.json#56#content.en: Ooh, it appears that the architect has chosen a high-ceiling construction to most effectively dissipate sound frequencies, while the placement of ambient lights suggests a design philosophy with a particular focus on minimizing eye strain.

StoryData/E100X.json#57#content.zh: 根据优先考虑隔音的结构、高效的人流引导以及整体构造，可以得出结论：我们刚刚踏入的地方，正是……！
StoryData/E100X.json#57#content.en: One may arrive at a conclusion that, based on structure prioritizing soundproofing, efficient foot traffic guidance, and the general construction, we have just stepped foot into none other than...!

StoryData/E100X.json#58#content.zh: 有好多书。应该是图书馆吧。
StoryData/E100X.json#58#content.en: It's got lots of books. Must be a library.

StoryData/E100X.json#59#content.zh: 图书— *咳咳* 诚然，辛克莱所言不虚。此处应是图书馆。
StoryData/E100X.json#59#content.en: A lib— *cough* Indeed, Sinclair speaks true. It must be a library.

StoryData/E100X.json#60#content.zh: 在以前的某次瓦尔普吉斯之夜里，我们曾在一本“书”里战斗过……
StoryData/E100X.json#60#content.en: We fought inside a "Book" in one of these past Walpurgis Nights...

StoryData/E100X.json#61#content.zh: 那这里就不是随便哪个图书馆，而是那个图书馆，满满当当装着那种“书”……
StoryData/E100X.json#61#content.en: Then this isn't just any other library, but the Library, filled to the brim with those "Books"...

StoryData/E100X.json#62#content.zh: 啊，对了！但丁，在你走之前……你该把图书馆加进你的行程里。
StoryData/E100X.json#62#content.en: Ah, wait! Before you go, Dante... you should add the Library to your itinerary.

StoryData/E100X.json#63#content.zh: ……她说的是哪个图书馆，再明显不过了。
StoryData/E100X.json#63#content.en: ... Seems pretty obvious which library she was referring to.

StoryData/E100X.json#65#content.zh: 是的。未发现任何连接问题。不过……
StoryData/E100X.json#65#content.en: Yes. No connection issues have been identified. However...

StoryData/E100X.json#66#content.zh: ……为防将来再发生类似的连接问题，浮士德最近一直在努力减少对它的依赖。何况无论您想查询什么信息，恐怕都派不上多大用场。
StoryData/E100X.json#66#content.en: ... I have been making efforts to reduce my reliance in recent days, in case similar connection issues occur in the future. Whatever information you would like to request is unlikely to be of much utility, either.

StoryData/E100X.json#67#content.zh: ……自从轮到良秀那次之后，浮士德和Gesellschaft之间显然一直有些不对劲。而且它们给我们的信息也确实没什么用……
StoryData/E100X.json#67#content.en: ... Clearly, something's been off-kilter with Faust and the Gesellschaft ever since Ryōshū had her turn. And it's true that they've been giving us some pretty useless information, too...

StoryData/E100X.json#69#content.en: <Well, then... care to share your own thoughts instead?>

StoryData/E100X.json#71#content.zh: 根据此前查阅的信息和眼前的景象推断，可以认为我们已进入曾被定为“杂质”的存在——图书馆的最深层。更准确地说，我们现在位于其最底层，被称为“历史层”。
StoryData/E100X.json#71#content.en: Deducing from the previously observed information and the visual evidence before us, it can be presumed that we have entered the deepest floor of an entity previously designated Impuritas Civitatis: The Library. To be more precise, we are now on its lowest floor, designated "The Floor of History."

StoryData/E100X.json#72#content.zh: 嗯……我们终于来到了图书馆。
StoryData/E100X.json#72#content.en: Hmmm... Thus we arrive at the Library at last.

StoryData/E100X.json#73#content.zh: 我认为，这又为我们此前讨论的“压力逐步递增”假说添了一项证据。
StoryData/E100X.json#73#content.en: I say this is another in the lengthening list of evidence in favor of the incrementally progressive pressure hypothesis we had discussed.

StoryData/E100X.json#74#content.zh: 正是。起初是遭遇大家都相当熟悉的异想体，之后发展为图书馆外的事件，而如今，我们已身处建筑内部的历史层。
StoryData/E100X.json#74#content.en: Indeed. It first began with an encounter with an Abnormality, a subject we were all rather familiar with, before progressing to an event outside the Library, and now we find ourselves on the Floor of History within the building itself.

StoryData/E100X.json#75#content.zh: 这与我们在旧L公司的情境中观察到的风险递增如出一辙；可以放心预计，这一趋势还会持续下去。
StoryData/E100X.json#75#content.en: It is very much in the same fashion as the mounting risk we had observed in the scenarios of the former L Corp.; it seems we can safely expect this trend to continue.

StoryData/E100X.json#76#content.zh: <那我们接下来要参与的是什么样的情境……？>
StoryData/E100X.json#76#content.en: <Then what kind of scenario are we about to...?>

StoryData/E100X.json#77#content.zh: 既然舞台设在图书馆内，可以很有把握地说，我们将参与一场“接待”。
StoryData/E100X.json#77#content.en: As it is set within the walls of the Library, it can be said with confidence that we will be participating in a "Reception."

StoryData/E100X.json#78#content.zh: 不过，至于我们扮演的是接受了图书馆邀请的客人，还是图书馆的司书……目前还没有任何证据能说明是哪一方。
StoryData/E100X.json#78#content.en: However, regarding whether we are to play the guests who have accepted the Library's invitation or its librarians... there is no evidence suggesting either way.

StoryData/E100X.json#80#content.zh: 啊，啊。测试。大家能听到吗？
StoryData/E100X.json#80#content.en: Ahh, ahh. Testing. Can everyone hear me?

StoryData/E100X.json#81#content.zh: <……？这个声音……我好像在哪儿听过。>
StoryData/E100X.json#81#content.en: <...? This voice... I feel like I've heard it before.>

StoryData/E100X.json#82#content.zh: 这个声音似乎属于在旧L公司的某个情境中，对我们的战斗表现做过点评的人之一。
StoryData/E100X.json#82#content.en: It seems that this voice belongs to one of those who had commented on our combat performance in one of our scenarios in the former L Corp.

StoryData/E100X.json#83#content.zh: 我记得，这个声音的主人曾自我介绍为“Malkuth”。
StoryData/E100X.json#83#content.en: This particular voice, I believe, had introduced herself as "Malkuth."

StoryData/E100X.json#84#content.zh: <哦……原来是她？这次听起来稍微有点不一样……>
StoryData/E100X.json#84#content.en: <Ohh... this is her? She sounds ever-so-slightly different this time...>

StoryData/E100X.json#85#title.en: Patron Librarian of the Floor of History

StoryData/E100X.json#85#content.zh: 抱歉，各位。按理说，我身为指定司书，应该亲自上前线才对……
StoryData/E100X.json#85#content.en: Sorry, everyone. Normally, I should be out there on the front lines as the Patron Librarian...

StoryData/E100X.json#86#title.en: Patron Librarian of the Floor of History

StoryData/E100X.json#86#content.zh: 可是@#$%!，所以我现在没法亲自到场。我不在的时候，得由你们中的一个人来担任指定司书。
StoryData/E100X.json#86#content.en: But @#$%!, so I can't be there in person right now. One of you is going to have to take up the Patron Librarian role while I'm unavailable.

StoryData/E100X.json#87#content.zh: 突然，一阵刺耳的嗡鸣声切进了Malkuth的话，打断了部分内容。
StoryData/E100X.json#87#content.en: Suddenly, a loud, auditory buzz cut into Malkuth's voice mid-sentence, disrupting a part of the message.

StoryData/E100X.json#88#content.zh: 现实像这样卡顿的声音，我们已经听过很多次了。我几乎不觉得惊讶。
StoryData/E100X.json#88#content.en: We'd heard reality hiccup like this often enough by now. I found myself hardly surprised.

StoryData/E100X.json#89#content.zh: ……某些信息被隐瞒的方式似乎带有一定的刻意性。或许是有什么东西为了解释我们“插入”这个情境，特意抹去了相关的差错。
StoryData/E100X.json#89#content.en: ... There appears to be a degree of intentionality in how certain information is concealed from us. Perhaps something has contrived to erase the error in question to explain our "insertion" into this scenario.

StoryData/E100X.json#91#content.zh: 哎呀，还有更多疑问等着呢；这“指定司书”究竟是何种职务，竟需吾等之中一人代她担此重任？
StoryData/E100X.json#91#content.en: Alas, further curiosities await; what manner of office is this "Patron Librarian," that one among us must take up the mantle in her stead?

StoryData/E100X.json#92#content.zh: 可以说……指定司书就是负责管理图书馆中所分配楼层各项事务的人。
StoryData/E100X.json#92#content.en: One could say that... a Patron Librarian is an individual responsible for managing various aspects of their assigned floor within the Library.

StoryData/E100X.json#93#content.zh: 哦，有点像那个……我们在美食广场碰到的那个好多条胳膊的家伙？
StoryData/E100X.json#93#content.en: Ohh, kinda like that... that fella with many arms we met at the Food Court?

StoryData/E100X.json#94#content.zh: 是的，拿楼层经理来类比很贴切。
StoryData/E100X.json#94#content.en: Yes, a Floor Manager makes for an apt comparison.

StoryData/E100X.json#95#title.en: Patron Librarian of the Floor of History

StoryData/E100X.json#95#content.zh: 不过嘛，你们现在都已经是接待的老手了，对吧？我知道你们搞得定的！
StoryData/E100X.json#95#content.en: But hey, you've all become total veterans at Receptions by now, haven't you? I know you guys have this handled!

StoryData/E100X.json#96#content.zh: 等、等一下！汝所说的这“接待”究竟为何物？
StoryData/E100X.json#96#content.en: P-prithee, hold! What be this "Reception" thou speakest of?

StoryData/E100X.json#97#content.zh: 就是司书接待受邀来到图书馆的客人的过程。
StoryData/E100X.json#97#content.en: It is the process by which Librarians receive guests invited to the Library.

StoryData/E100X.json#99#content.en: ... By engaging them through physical means.

StoryData/E100X.json#101#content.zh: 说白了，就是挂着客服名牌的殊死搏斗嘛……
StoryData/E100X.json#101#content.en: So it's basically a fight to the death with a customer-service name tag pinned to it...

StoryData/E100X.json#102#content.zh: 那么，今天的客人是谁呀~？
StoryData/E100X.json#102#content.en: So, who are today's guests, then~?

StoryData/E100X.json#103#title.en: Patron Librarian of the Floor of History

StoryData/E100X.json#103#content.zh: 这个嘛……安吉拉从来都不肯告诉我什么。我只听说了名字。好像是叫“黎明事务所”？
StoryData/E100X.json#103#content.en: Well... it's not like Angela ever lets me in on anything. I only heard the name. "Dawn Office," I think?

StoryData/E100X.json#104#content.zh: 黎、黎明事务所？！就是由烙印工坊赞助的那个事务所？！汝说的是那个黎明事务所？！
StoryData/E100X.json#104#content.en: D-Dawn Office?! The very Office sponsored by Stigma Workshop?! That Dawn Office, thou sayest?!

StoryData/E100X.json#105#content.zh: 呜……！若早知会有这番幸运的相遇，吾出发前便该换一套徽章收藏！尤其是黎明事务所的徽章，那是收尾人杂志访谈附赠的限定特典，吾正是为数不多持有它的收藏家之一！啊，还有什么旗帜比它更能将吾之仰慕彰显于胸前……！
StoryData/E100X.json#105#content.en: Ghh...! Had I but foreseen this blessed meeting, I would have worn a different badge colección ere we departed! The Dawn Office badge in particular was offered solely as a limited bonus with a Fixer magazine interview, and I am counted among the precious few collectors who possess one! Ah, what truer banner of mine admiration could I have borne upon my chest...!

StoryData/E100X.json#106#title.en: Patron Librarian of the Floor of History

StoryData/E100X.json#106#content.zh: 原来真有司书听说过他们！那我就放心了。
StoryData/E100X.json#106#content.en: So there is a Librarian who's heard of them! That's a relief.

StoryData/E100X.json#107#title.en: Patron Librarian of the Floor of History

StoryData/E100X.json#107#content.zh: 又像……以前那样被困在后勤岗位上，说实话我不太开心，但我会陪着你们直到一切结束。所以……
StoryData/E100X.json#107#content.en: I'm not exactly thrilled about being stuck on support duty again like... before, but I'll stay with you until everything is over. So...

StoryData/E100X.json#108#title.en: Patron Librarian of the Floor of History

StoryData/E100X.json#108#content.zh: 大家，请不要死。像往常一样去做，我们这次也一定能挺过去。
StoryData/E100X.json#108#content.en: Please don't die, everyone. Let's do what we always do, and we'll make it through again.

StoryData/E100X.json#110#content.zh: 她的声音和我记忆中一样充满活力。只是如今，她说话的方式里似乎有什么东西落定了——某种更加饱满的东西。
StoryData/E100X.json#110#content.en: Her voice was just as energetic as I remembered. Only now, something seemed to have settled into place in the way she spoke—something fuller.

StoryData/E100X.json#114#content.zh: 啊。这些人似乎很乐意接待我们，和安吉拉不一样。
StoryData/E100X.json#114#content.en: Ah. These people seem rather glad to receive us, unlike Angela.

StoryData/E100X.json#115#content.zh: 师父……！我们是不是该再保持点距离——
StoryData/E100X.json#115#content.en: Master...! Maybe we should keep a little more distance—

StoryData/E100X.json#117#content.zh: 哦吼！小奥提斯，看来汝也因亲眼目睹如此著名的收尾人之风采而惊得说不出话来了！
StoryData/E100X.json#117#content.en: Oho! Young Outis, I see that thou too art struck speechless by the splendor of beholding such famed Fixers in the flesh!

StoryData/E100X.json#119#content.zh: 这些没意义的闲聊太让人泄气了，老爷子。赶紧解决掉，拿了Zwei协会的书就走吧。
StoryData/E100X.json#119#content.en: All this pointless chit-chat is killing my excitement, gramps. Let's get this over with, collect the Book of Zwei Association, and get out of here.

StoryData/E100X.json#120#content.zh: 前辈……我们是不是至少该先摸清他们的底细……？
StoryData/E100X.json#120#content.en: Seonbae... shouldn't we at least get a read on them first...?

StoryData/E100X.json#121#content.zh: *呵呵* 菲利普。你再绷这么紧，可要断成两截了。
StoryData/E100X.json#121#content.en: *chuckle* Philip. You'll snap in half if you wind yourself any tighter.

StoryData/E100X.json#122#content.zh: <看来那边那位老人就是事务所的代表了。>
StoryData/E100X.json#122#content.en: <Looks like that old man over there's the Office rep.>

StoryData/E100X.json#123#content.zh: 正是！看哪，汝眼前这位正是黎明事务所的代表——
StoryData/E100X.json#123#content.en: Correct! Behold, for thou'rt in the presence of the Representative of Dawn Office—

StoryData/E100X.json#125#content.zh: 嗯？小奥提斯，汝与萨尔瓦多阁下相识吗？
StoryData/E100X.json#125#content.en: Eh? Young Outis, art thou acquainted with Sir Salvador?

StoryData/E100X.json#126#content.zh: 不，我从未见过他本人。不过……
StoryData/E100X.json#126#content.en: No, I've never met him in person. However...

StoryData/E100X.json#129#content.zh: 其实根本没必要问她是怎么知道的。
StoryData/E100X.json#129#content.en: There really wasn't any need to ask how she knew.

StoryData/E100X.json#130#content.zh: 奥提斯脸上的表情，已经足以回答这个问题。
StoryData/E100X.json#130#content.en: That look on Outis's face answered the question well enough.

StoryData/P11116.json#0#content.zh: [第5A71-1号报告。日常活动记录及证明材料。提交人：奥提斯，楔子事务所代表。]
StoryData/P11116.json#0#content.en: [Report No. 5A71-1. Routine Activity Record and Supporting Documentation. Filed by Outis, Representative of Wedge Office.]

StoryData/P11116.json#1#content.zh: 今日，我接收了合作事务所留下的遗物。
StoryData/P11116.json#1#content.en: Today, I took custody of the effects left behind by our partner Office.

StoryData/P11116.json#2#content.zh: 清单包括一摞报告、大量委托书、几套换洗衣物，以及备用武器……
StoryData/P11116.json#2#content.en: The inventory runs to a stack of reports, a substantial number of contracts, several changes of clothes, and weapons kept in reserve...

StoryData/P11116.json#4#content.zh: 我认为没有必要记下他的名字。把他作为可用的战力编入本事务所是绝无可能的；他的性情与本事务所完全不合。
StoryData/P11116.json#4#content.en: I see no need to enter his name. There is no question of bringing him into this Office as an asset we could use; his temperament is altogether unsuited to this Office.

StoryData/P11116.json#5#content.zh: 同样，我也无法想象他被放任自生自灭后还能闯出一条路来。别说闯出名堂了，他连为保命而战的骨气都几乎没有。
StoryData/P11116.json#5#content.en: Equally, I cannot picture him making his way if turned out to fend for himself. He scarcely has the grit to fight for his life, let alone make a name for himself.

StoryData/P11116.json#6#content.zh: 黎明事务所的收尾人“A”。这样就足够了。
StoryData/P11116.json#6#content.en: Fixer "A" of the Dawn Office. That will suffice.

StoryData/P11116.json#7#content.zh: 没错，收尾人A。对日后核对收尾人死亡名单的人来说，这样的身份标识应该足够了。
StoryData/P11116.json#7#content.en: Yes, Fixer A. For anyone who eventually cross-checks the Fixer death rolls, that should be identification enough.

StoryData/P11116.json#8#content.zh: 为收集情报，我进行了简短的问询。
StoryData/P11116.json#8#content.en: I conducted a brief interview for the purpose of gathering intel.

StoryData/P11116.json#9#content.zh: 如今我已掌握了同胞事务所所经历的事件始末、他们采取的行动……以及他们是如何落到这般可悲的结局的。
StoryData/P11116.json#9#content.en: I now have the sequence of events that transpired with our sister Office, the course they took... and an account of how they reached this deplorable outcome.

StoryData/P11116.json#10#content.zh: 他们在战斗力上胜过我们。与他们协同作战，让我们得以弥补自身能力上的这一短板……
StoryData/P11116.json#10#content.en: They had the edge over us in combat. Working alongside them had allowed us to shore up that weakness in our own capabilities...

StoryData/P11116.json#11#content.zh: 然而，由于缺乏正确的判断，那份实力最终也不起作用。尽管如此，我无法否认，未能与他们会合多少令我感到遗憾。
StoryData/P11116.json#11#content.en: Yet all that strength came to nothing for want of sound judgment. Still, I cannot deny some regret that we were unable to join them.

StoryData/P11116.json#12#content.zh: 他们没能毫不犹豫地把这个……多愁善感的软弱之人赶出门去……或许也是同一缺陷的又一症状。
StoryData/P11116.json#12#content.en: Their inability to show this... sentimental weakling the door without hesitation... may have been another symptom of the same failing.

StoryData/P11116.json#13#content.zh: 为了茶，真的值得把他留下吗？我承认，双和茶确实泡得出色……但这里是事务所，不是茶馆。泡茶的手艺再好，也不能让那个决定变得合理。
StoryData/P11116.json#13#content.en: Was the tea really worth keeping him on for? The ssanghwa-cha is exceptional, I grant that... but this is an Office, not a tearoom. A gifted tea-maker does not make that decision a sound one.

StoryData/P11116.json#14#content.zh: 心软过了头。我那位老朋友的毛病一直就在这里……
StoryData/P11116.json#14#content.en: Softhearted to a fault. That was always the trouble with that old friend of mine...

StoryData/P11116.json#15#content.zh: ……回到本报告的主旨：我方不得不拒绝了同胞事务所的支援请求。拒绝的理由同样应当记录在案。
StoryData/P11116.json#15#content.en: ... Returning to the purpose of this report: we were obliged to refuse our sister Office's request for assistance. The grounds for that refusal should also be placed on record.

StoryData/P11116.json#16#content.zh: 8点档马戏团给我们带来了不少麻烦。
StoryData/P11116.json#16#content.en: The 8 o'clock Circus gave us no shortage of trouble.

StoryData/P11116.json#17#content.zh: 我不认为这归咎于那个被称作马戏团“团长”的小丑。他的实力并不出众。若只是他与我单独交手，我判断不会有太大困难。
StoryData/P11116.json#17#content.en: I do not attribute that to the clown called the "ringmaster" of the Circus. His strength was nothing extraordinary. Had the encounter been confined to him and me, I doubt there would have been any great difficulty.

StoryData/P11116.json#18#content.zh: 让事态复杂化的，是那些被称作他“朋友”的怪异生物——也就是他的团员们。
StoryData/P11116.json#18#content.en: What complicated matters were the grotesque creatures described as his "friends"—that is, his troupe members.

StoryData/P11116.json#19#content.zh: 若它们的战略或战术有某种规律可循，我们至少还能有所应对，但它们毫无规律。我甚至察觉不到指导它们行动的任何共同程序。
StoryData/P11116.json#19#content.en: A pattern in their strategy or tactics would at least have given us something to work with, but there was none. I could not even detect a common procedure guiding their actions.

StoryData/P11116.json#20#content.zh: 它们的下一步行动谁也说不准……一场让人无法预料下一个节目的马戏表演，没错。别的不说，这名字倒是起得恰如其分。无论从哪层意义上来说。
StoryData/P11116.json#20#content.en: Their next move was anyone's guess... A circus performance whose next show was nothing predictable, yes. It was well named, if nothing else. In every sense of the word.

StoryData/P11116.json#21#content.zh: 我方一名收尾人在战斗中身体几近全毁。袭击者形似狮子。若掌握更多辨识特征，我会一并提供……但我当时正在别处交战，没能看清那个实体。
StoryData/P11116.json#21#content.en: One of our own Fixers had his body all but destroyed in the fighting. The attacker resembled a lion. I would provide more identifying details if I had them... but I was engaged elsewhere and didn't get a clear look at the entity.

StoryData/P11116.json#22#content.zh: 有一段时间，我曾考虑过最坏的可能：我麾下的收尾人全数阵亡，事务所本身的存续也岌岌可危……然而，我们一点点将敌人逼退，最终将其逼入绝境。或许算是幸运……
StoryData/P11116.json#22#content.en: For a time, I had considered the worst-case possibility: every Fixer under my command lost, and the Office's very survival in question... Little by little, however, we forced the enemy back and finally brought them to bay. Fortunate, perhaps...

StoryData/P11116.json#23#content.zh: 就在那时，团长带着几名看似地位较高的团员撤退了。我方已无力追击。我方随之撤离，委托也因此未能完成。
StoryData/P11116.json#23#content.en: That was when the ringmaster took several apparently higher-ranking troupe members and retreated. We were in no condition to give pursuit. Our own withdrawal left the contract unfinished.

StoryData/P11116.json#24#content.zh: 至少，我们事先投保了那份生命保险。保险足以让那名收尾人通过以防万一而克隆的同一副身体复原……
StoryData/P11116.json#24#content.en: We had, at least, taken out that life insurance in advance. It proved sufficient to restore the Fixer via the same body that had been cloned just in case...

StoryData/P11116.json#25#content.zh: 然而，该保单无法提供的，是在身体转移后立即恢复身体能力。我认为，这足以解释我方为何无法响应支援请求。
StoryData/P11116.json#25#content.en: What the policy could not offer, however, was the immediate restoration of physical abilities following the body transfer. That, I submit, is ample explanation for our inability to answer the request assistance.

StoryData/P11116.json#26#content.zh: 若하나协会下属的事务所信用评估委员会日后要就此事追究，望其对上述事实予以应有的考虑。
StoryData/P11116.json#26#content.en: Should the Office Credit Assessment Committee under the Hana Association choose to make an issue of this at a later date, I trust it will give these facts their due consideration.

StoryData/P11116.json#27#content.zh: 随附以下两份证明文件：
StoryData/P11116.json#27#content.en: The following two documents are appended in support:

StoryData/P11116.json#28#content.zh: 无分红安心收尾人损害保险B型缴费记录及费用报销申请书一份。
StoryData/P11116.json#28#content.en: One copy of the payment record and expense-reimbursement claim for Non-participating Safe Solution Fixer Indemnity Insurance, Type B.

StoryData/P11116.json#29#content.zh: 通称“8点档马戏团”的清除委托战斗记录一份。
StoryData/P11116.json#29#content.en: One copy of the combat record for the elimination contract against the 8 o'clock Circus, as it is commonly known.

StoryData/P11116.json#30#content.zh: ……我总觉得，8点档马戏团还会继续肆虐很久。或许应当另行提交报告，提请协会注意。
StoryData/P11116.json#30#content.en: ... Something tells me the 8 o'clock Circus still has a great deal of havoc left to wreak. It may be prudent to bring this to the Association's attention in a separate report.

StoryData/P11116.json#31#content.zh: 等下一份委托结束后，我会着手处理。
StoryData/P11116.json#31#content.en: I should attend to it once the next contract is concluded.

StoryData/P11116.json#32#content.zh: 啊，不过有一点需要明确，以免产生争议。
StoryData/P11116.json#32#content.en: Ah, but one point needs putting beyond dispute.

StoryData/P11116.json#33#content.zh: 此事与为合作事务所复仇无关。也并非出于想给那个麻烦的遗物——他们曾经的新人成员——帮什么忙。
StoryData/P11116.json#33#content.en: No vengeance for our partner Office is involved here. Nor any desire to do a favor for that troublesome piece of salvage that had been their rookie member.

StoryData/P11116.json#34#content.zh: 想必已经十分明了，我并没有无私行事的习惯。
StoryData/P11116.json#34#content.en: As should be abundantly clear, I am not in the habit of acting selflessly.

StoryData/P11116.json#35#content.zh: 这只是一份工作，仅此而已。
StoryData/P11116.json#35#content.en: This is a job, plain and simple.

StoryData/P11116.json#36#content.zh: 当然，这也是在向一位已故的老朋友致意。不过，这一点终究只是次要的。完成委托永远是第一位的。
StoryData/P11116.json#36#content.en: Of course, it is also a matter of paying my respects to an old friend, now deceased. That consideration, however, remains strictly secondary. Completing the contract always comes first.

StoryData/P11116.json#37#content.zh: 楔子事务所的一贯方针是准确评估眼前的局势，迅速果断地完成每一份委托。我们只是一如既往地遵循这一方针行事。
StoryData/P11116.json#37#content.en: Wedge Office's standing directive is to assess the situation at hand accurately and bring each contract to a swift, decisive conclusion. We are simply acting in accordance with that directive, as we always have.

StoryData/P11116.json#38#content.zh: ……不过，就说到这里吧。我们该着手执行委托了。
StoryData/P11116.json#38#content.en: ... But enough of this. We should be getting underway with the contract.

StoryData/P11116.json#39#content.zh: 那个缩在角落里坐立不安、满心焦躁地等着别人告诉他何时出发去图书馆的可怜相，我已经看够了。
StoryData/P11116.json#39#content.en: I have had my fill of the sorry spectacle fidgeting in that corner: all nerves and impatience, waiting to be told when we will leave for the Library.

StoryData/P11116.json#40#content.zh: ……嗯。这倒让我想起来了。我们收来的遗物里，有一件相当特别。
StoryData/P11116.json#40#content.en: ... Hm. That reminds me. One of the effects we collected was rather unusual.

StoryData/P11116.json#41#content.zh: 我并不太情愿使用它。不过……或许我那位心软的朋友，正是为了这个目的才把它留下的。
StoryData/P11116.json#41#content.en: Using it doesn't sit well with me. Still... perhaps that softhearted friend of mine left it for precisely that purpose.

StoryData/P11116.json#42#content.zh: 至于使用者会落到哪里，我无从知晓。不过……我总不能连每一个细节都替他照顾到。
StoryData/P11116.json#42#content.en: As for where its user would land, I cannot say. But... I can hardly be expected to look after every last detail.

StoryData/P11116.json#43#content.en: I will conclude my report here.

StoryData/P11116.json#44#content.zh: ……嗯。等到了图书馆，或许我该问问，那位老朋友的书最后有多厚。
StoryData/P11116.json#44#content.en: ... Hm. Once we arrive at the Library, perhaps I will ask how thick that old friend's book turned out to be.

StoryData/E101X.json#0#content.zh: 经理，我已回收了他们的书。
StoryData/E101X.json#0#content.en: Manager, I have retrieved their books.

StoryData/E101X.json#1#content.zh: 战斗结束后，默尔索收起了两本曾是收尾人的书，交到我手上。
StoryData/E101X.json#1#content.en: After the battle, Meursault collected two books that had once been Fixers and handed them to me.

StoryData/E101X.json#2#content.en: They are heavier than their appearance would suggest.

StoryData/E101X.json#3#content.zh: <哇，还真是。这里面到底装了什么……？>
StoryData/E101X.json#3#content.en: <Whoa, no kidding. What could even be inside these...?>

StoryData/E101X.json#4#content.zh: 确是如此……其厚度，令人不禁想象每一段人生都被一字不漏地誊写在了纸上。
StoryData/E101X.json#4#content.en: Indeed... A thickness such that one might imagine each life had been transcribed upon the page without omission.

StoryData/E101X.json#5#content.zh: 我掀开沉重的封面，刚要翻到第一页——
StoryData/E101X.json#5#content.en: I lifted the heavy cover and had barely begun to turn toward the first page when—

StoryData/E101X.json#7#content.zh: 手中的书就仿佛从未存在过一般消失了。
StoryData/E101X.json#7#content.en: The book in my hands vanished as if it had never existed.

StoryData/E101X.json#10#content.zh: ——一支黑色的枪尖朝我的脑袋直飞而来。良秀千钧一发之际将它挡开……
StoryData/E101X.json#10#content.en: —a black spearhead, hurtling toward my head. Ryōshū knocked it aside by the narrowest margin...

StoryData/E101X.json#11#content.zh: 与此同时，奥提斯格开了另外两支朝我们飞来的枪尖，随即转身面向我。
StoryData/E101X.json#11#content.en: At the same time, Outis deflected two more spearpoints flying toward us, then spun back toward me.

StoryData/E101X.json#12#content.zh: 执行经理！您没有受伤吧？！

StoryData/E101X.json#15#content.zh: 但丁。这一局面中有诸多反常之处，您感到困惑是可以理解的。但眼下，我们应当专注于面前的情境。
StoryData/E101X.json#15#content.en: Dante. It is understandable that you would be puzzled by the numerous irregularities in this situation. For the moment, however, we should focus on the scenario before us.

StoryData/E101X.json#19#content.zh: “钟·头”？那是你们领头人的名字吗？

StoryData/E101X.json#20#content.zh: 总之……没错，我是冲着他去的。以我的经验，先解决掉领头人，似乎是我们活着离开这里的最好机会。可惜了。
StoryData/E101X.json#20#content.en: In any case... yes, I was. Speaking from experience, taking the leader out first seemed like our best shot at getting out of this place alive. Pity.

StoryData/E101X.json#21#content.zh: 等我再看过去时，那个男人已经回到了同伴身边，悠然甩去枪刃上沾着的我的血。
StoryData/E101X.json#21#content.en: By the time I looked again, the man was already beside his companions, idly shaking my blood from the edge of his spear.

StoryData/E101X.json#22#content.zh: 帕梅菈。帕梅莉。按原定计划行动。
StoryData/E101X.json#22#content.en: Pamela. Pameli. We proceed per our original plan.

StoryData/E101X.json#23#content.zh: 我们可不能为了让你实现那套“理想”就全都去死。
StoryData/E101X.json#23#content.en: We can't all die just for you to fulfill your "ideals."

StoryData/E101X.json#24#content.zh: 在楼下已经跟你说过了：你要是挡我们的路，我们就亲手把你捅穿。
StoryData/E101X.json#24#content.en: Like you were told downstairs: if you get in our way, we'll run you through ourselves.

StoryData/E101X.json#26#content.zh: 嗯……？经理，那不是刚才逃走的那家伙吗……？
StoryData/E101X.json#26#content.en: Huh...? Manager, isn't he the guy who ran away a moment ago...?

StoryData/E101X.json#27#content.zh: 搞什么……？另外两个人拼了命才救下他的小命，他居然又直接跑回来了？图什么啊？
StoryData/E101X.json#27#content.en: The heck...? After everything the other two burned just to save his butt, he just comes runnin' straight back? What for?

StoryData/E101X.json#28#content.zh: 肯定是报仇呗，对吧。瞧瞧他那样。那家伙就是那种一上头就什么都不管、只顾往前冲的类型。
StoryData/E101X.json#28#content.en: Got to be revenge, innit. Just look at him. Bloke's one of those bugger-all-else-and-move types the moment the blood rushes to their heads.

StoryData/E101X.json#30#content.zh: 双方都僵在原地，彼此间的紧张如弦紧绷，都在等着看谁先把它扯断。
StoryData/E101X.json#30#content.en: Both sides stood frozen in place, tension drawn taut between us, each waiting to see who would snap it first.

StoryData/E101X.json#31#content.zh: 反正过一会儿我们就要拼个你死我活了……
StoryData/E101X.json#31#content.en: We'll be at each other's throats in a moment anyway...

StoryData/E101X.json#32#content.zh: 所以在那之前，陪我聊几句吧。

StoryData/E101X.json#33#content.zh: 刚才想用枪刺我的那位老收尾人走上前来。
StoryData/E101X.json#33#content.en: The old Fixer who had tried to spear me stepped forward.

StoryData/E101X.json#36#content.zh: 我不知道该如何回答。正当我犹豫着、在脑中斟酌措辞时……
StoryData/E101X.json#36#content.en: I wasn't sure how to respond. As I hesitated, mulling over the words in my head...

StoryData/E101X.json#37#content.zh: 李箱走上前，轻声回答了这个问题。
StoryData/E101X.json#37#content.en: Yi Sang stepped forward, answering the question in a quiet voice.

StoryData/E101X.json#40#content.en: ... That's all I needed to hear.

StoryData/E102X.json#0#content.zh: ……我不想把自己的动机粉饰成是为了别人。
StoryData/E102X.json#0#content.en: ... I don’t want to embellish my motives saying it's for others.

StoryData/E102X.json#1#content.zh: 我做这一切都是为了我自己。
StoryData/E102X.json#1#content.en: I was doing it all for me.

StoryData/E102X.json#2#content.zh: 比什么都更是为了我自己。

StoryData/E102X.json#3#content.zh: 为了比任何人都更悲伤的我……
StoryData/E102X.json#3#content.en: For me, who's feeling sadder than anyone...

StoryData/E102X.json#6#content.zh: ……这或许正是这个情境想让我们看到的。
StoryData/E102X.json#6#content.en: ... It is possible that this is what the scenario was meant to show us.

StoryData/E102X.json#7#content.zh: ……就算我悲伤，也不会有人替我哭泣。
StoryData/E102X.json#7#content.en: ... No one's going to cry on my behalf even if I'm sad.

StoryData/E102X.json#8#content.zh: 如果我非得……背负着这份情感，如果我没法摆脱它……
StoryData/E102X.json#8#content.en: If I must... carry this emotion, if I can't get rid of it...

StoryData/E102X.json#9#content.zh: 那我就选择带着这份悲伤重新站起来。
StoryData/E102X.json#9#content.en: Then I'll take the path of getting back on my feet with this sadness instead.

StoryData/E102X.json#11#content.zh: 这份力量一定是赐予我的机会。
StoryData/E102X.json#11#content.en: This power has to be an opportunity given to me.

StoryData/E103X.json#0#content.zh: 他那充满复仇之念的痛苦渐行渐远，直到连那声音也消散得无影无踪。等我的视线稳定下来时，眼前只剩下熟悉的巴士走廊，以及沿着走廊排成一长列的门。
StoryData/E103X.json#0#content.en: His vengeful anguish drifted farther and farther away until even that sound scattered without a trace. By the time my vision settled, all that remained was the familiar sight of our bus's corridor and the long row of doors lining it.

StoryData/E103X.json#1#content.en: ... It seems that this is where this scenario ends.

StoryData/E103X.json#2#content.en: <That felt a lot longer than usual...>

StoryData/E103X.json#3#content.zh: 是的。这会让其变量的计算复杂得多。
StoryData/E103X.json#3#content.en: Yes. Which will make calculating its variables considerably more complex.
