StoryData/E103X.json#4#content.zh: 而且每当情境似乎就要收尾时，它又会在边缘缝上另一块碎片，仿佛不肯让这条线就此终结……
StoryData/E103X.json#4#content.en: And whenever the scenario seemed poised to close, it stitched another fragment onto its edge as though it refused to let the thread end there...

StoryData/E103X.json#5#content.zh: <浮士德，我有件事一直很在意……>
StoryData/E103X.json#5#content.en: <Faust, there's something I've been wondering about...>

StoryData/E103X.json#7#content.zh: 如果这个情境唯一的目的就是让我们看到某人绽放E.G.O，又何必让我们如此紧密地追随菲利普的脚步？真是那样的话，只要让我们看到这个过程最后的那一闪就够了。
StoryData/E103X.json#7#content.en: If showing us someone Effloresce an E.G.O had been the sole point of this scenario, why make us trail Philip's footsteps so closely? If it were, all it had to do was show us the final flicker of the process.

StoryData/E103X.json#8#content.zh: 可这个情境给人的感觉，却像是想让我们陪着菲利普把他的故事本身走一遍。
StoryData/E103X.json#8#content.en: Instead, it felt as though the scenario wanted us to walk beside Philip's story itself.

StoryData/E103X.json#9#content.zh: 而如果它需要被构建成这样……
StoryData/E103X.json#9#content.en: And if it had needed to be built that way...

StoryData/E103X.json#10#content.zh: <你觉得，这个情境之所以被缝合得这么奇怪，是因为它想让我们看到绽放的完整过程吗？>
StoryData/E103X.json#10#content.en: entire process of Efflorescence?>

StoryData/E103X.json#13#content.zh: 或许……接待的过程本身，其意义并不亚于获取填满书架的书。
StoryData/E103X.json#13#content.en: Perhaps... the course of a Reception itself bears a significance no lesser than obtaining the books to fill the shelves.

StoryData/E103X.json#14#content.zh: ……我想过问李箱为什么会这样，但总觉得问了也没多大意义。
StoryData/E103X.json#14#content.en: ... I considered asking Yi Sang why that would be the case, but it didn't feel like there was much point in asking.

StoryData/E103X.json#15#content.zh: 不知为何，我觉得如果情境选择了含糊其辞，那它大概也有充分的理由。
StoryData/E103X.json#15#content.en: Something told me that, if the scenario had chosen to speak vaguely, then it probably had a good reason for doing so.

StoryData/E103X.json#16#content.zh: 眼下，我们能做的只有再走一遍，找找第一次可能遗漏的东西。
StoryData/E103X.json#16#content.en: For now, all we could do was walk it again and look for whatever might have slipped past us the first time.

StoryData/E103X.json#17#content.zh: <好吧，那我们再来一次，确保没漏掉什么。>
StoryData/E103X.json#17#content.en: <All right, then. Let's give it another go and make sure that we haven't missed anything.>

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: 最后刺穿敌人咽喉的可是吾之长枪！那一个理应算吾的吧？这样汝便是两个，小辛克莱。公平即是公平。 这算什么逻辑？那一个是我们两个一起捅穿的——所以一人两个半。说真的，你怎么能一本正经地说出这种话？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: 'Twas my spear that skewered the foe's throat last! Surely that kill is mine to claim? That leaves thee with two, young Sinclair. Fair's fair. What kind of logic is that? We both ran that one through—so that's two and a half each. Seriously, how do you say that with a straight face?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
小辛克莱！！快来橱柜这边……！劳驾，把麦片拿下来……！是谁把它放得这么高的？！
<color=#8b9c15>……我放的。当时我还够得着，现在够不着了。</color>
那、那个嘛……
<color=#8b9c15>我说，你当初要是肯好好看看保险的细则，我也不至于变成这样……</color>
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
Young Sinclair!! Come thee to the cupboard...! Prithee, fetch down the cereal...! Who saw fit to place it at such a lofty height?!
<color=#8b9c15>... I did. When I used to be able to reach it. Now I can't.</color>
W-well, that's...
<color=#8b9c15>You know, if you'd actually bothered to read the fine print on the insurance, I wouldn't have been stuck like this...</color>

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: “糖醋肉（Tangsuyuk）”。“牛肉汤（Yukgaejang）”！“火腿黄油法棍（Jambon-beurre）”。Re……“勒布罗申芝士焗土豆（Reblochon on potato gratin）”！呃……Tang……“汤包（Tangbao）”……？O……“蛋包饭（Omurice）”！汝意下如何？呵。“斯莫雷布洛（Smørrebrød）”。诶诶诶？！“Ble”？“Bro”？那是何种食物？！是一种开放式三明治。好了，看来今天的午饭你请。*呜呃* 好吧。吾这就去买份蛋包饭……打包。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: "Tangsuyuk". "Yukgaejang"! "Jambon-beurre". Re... "Reblochon on potato gratin"! Ugh... Tang... "Tangbao"...? O... "Omurice"! What sayest thou to that? Heh. "Smørrebrød". Ehhhh?! "Ble"? "Bro"? What manner of food is that?! It's an open-faced sandwich. All right, then. Guess you're buying lunch today. *groan* Very well. I shall fetch some omurice... to go.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
呜嗯……！*呼* *呼* 每天晚上……都是同一个噩梦——那些恶徒将小辛克莱撕得四分五裂，一遍又一遍……
<color=#8b9c15>……？你叫我？</color>
啊，不、不！没什么，什么事都没有！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
Nnngh...! *huff* *huff* Every evening... 'tis the same nightmare—those wretches tearing young Sinclair limb from limb, again and again...
<color=#8b9c15>...? Did you call me?</color>
Ah, n-nay! 'Tis nothing, nothing at all!

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
<color=#8b9c15>……堂吉诃德，你可别告诉我你忘了马上要续保的事。</color>
嗯？！不、不，当然没忘……！
<color=#8b9c15>……还有，把附加项目也过一遍。我发誓，你要是再忘了给克隆身体加上生长针剂的保障，我就……*唉*</color>
诚然，那是吾之过错……吾认错还认得不够多吗……？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
<color=#8b9c15>... Don Quixote, please tell me you haven't forgotten the upcoming insurance renewal.</color>
Hm?! N-nay, of course not...!
<color=#8b9c15>... And go over the add-ons. I swear, if you forget to get the clone body's growth shots covered again, I'm gonna... *sigh*</color>
'Twas my fault, forsooth... Have I not admitted my guilt often enough...?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: 啧……我说，你越来越让人受不了了。又没人说你错了什么。 诚然，吾等应给他一些空间，小辛克莱……他尚未恢复…… 不，够了。我们只是说这一单活儿可以一起干，因为你这种想法的收尾人跟我们事务所不合，就这么简单。结果你倒好，突然摆出一副苦大仇深的混账样！你能不能……算了。听着，你这小——别再板着张脸了行不行？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: Ugh... You know, you're getting insufferable. Nobody said you were wrong or anything. Verily, we ought to give him some space, young Sinclair... He hath yet to recover... No, enough is enough. All we said was we'll work together on this one job 'cause Fixers who think like you aren't a good fit for our Office, simple as that. And you had to be a miserable ass about it out of the blue! Could you please... never mind. Look, you little—stop frowning already, would you?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: 汝且看，楔子乃是与劈砍和碾压最为无缘的武器。看看吾这杆长枪针尖般锋利的枪头：汝看见了吗？！此乃效率无与伦比的武器！最为专一的一击、最为精细的专注，施展起来几乎无需多少力气。这便是与“楔子”相称的工作！ 因此！那些怀揣委托前来本事务所的人，期待的并非蛮力，不；而是迅捷与精准……建立在敏锐而精确的局势判断这一基石之上！嘿嘿，这便是吾等的事务所！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: A wedge, thou seest, is a weapon most divorced from cleaving and crushing. Behold the pinpoint-keen tip of this spear mine: dost thou see?! 'Tis a weapon of unparalleled efficiency! A strike most singular and focus most fine requireth little strength to execute. Such is the work befitting a "Wedge!" Consequently! Those who seek our Office with a quest in their bosom expect no brute strength, nay; 'tis swiftness and precision... founded upon the bedrock of shrewd and precise situational assessment! Heh heh, that is what our Office is!

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
<color=#8b9c15>现在可不是能讲礼貌的情况。我这就把你捅个对穿。</color>
身为收尾人，人命关天之际，吾实在顾不上礼数周全！汝定能理解吧！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
<color=#8b9c15>Not exactly the kind of situation where we can afford to be polite. I'll get to skewering you right away.</color>
As a Fixer, I can scarce afford proper etiquette when lives stand at stake! Surely thou canst understand!

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: <color=#8b9c15>我们事务所对那些喜欢把自己打扮成“无私”的混账尤其没耐心。要是其中最自私的那个自己还没意识到这一点，那就更是加倍。</color>
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: <color=#8b9c15>Our Office has particularly low tolerance for dickheads who like to dress themselves up as "selfless." Doubly so when the most selfish of them don't seem to realize that himself.</color>

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
<color=#8b9c15>……那个小混混还要赖在我们事务所多久？</color>
恳请汝耐心些！汝还记得奥提斯女士的保证吧？此番委托一完成，他便会离开。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
<color=#8b9c15>... How long is that punk going to leech on our Office?</color>
Prithee, practice patience! Thou recallest Lady Outis's reassurance, dost thou not? He shall depart anon following this contract's completion.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
<color=#8b9c15>喂，现在别瞪我们。我们只是戳你一下确认确认。</color>
嘿嘿，吾听闻汝本该是个“好人”——吾对汝别无所求，只盼汝慷慨到极致！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
<color=#8b9c15>Hey, don't glare at us now. We just poked you to make sure.</color>
Heh heh, I had heard that thou wert supposed to be "nice"—I expect naught else but the maximum generosity from thee!

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: 劳驾，小辛克莱！别挡着吾的位置！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: Prithee, young Sinclair! Stay clear of position mine!
I shall clear the way forth!

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: 吾须将全副心神投入眼前的战场！若有急事，去找小辛克莱！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: I must invest my focus entirely upon this battlefield before us! If it's urgent, take it to young Sinclair!

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: 哎呀！汝的成功，莫非是忘了该归功于谁？依吾之见，前半段全靠吾之——！！
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: Hoyday! Perchance thou hast forgotten someone to credit for thine success? I daresay the first half was made possible only thanks to my—!!

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh: 吾不是早就警告过汝，汝的方法有误——
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en: Have I not warned thee, that thine approach was misguid—

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
呼……又了结了一项委托！小辛克莱，稍事歇息如何？
<color=#8b9c15>虽然还有些头疼的事要处理……嗯，到这份上也无所谓了，对吧？</color>
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
Phew... That be one quest behind us! What sayest thou, young Sinclair, to a moment's respite?
<color=#8b9c15>We still have some headaches to deal with, but... Eh, it's whatever at this point, right?</color>

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
<color=#8b9c15>虽然他们给我们添了点麻烦，但——</color>
——诚然，委托一经接下，便没有吾等完成不了的！
<color=#8b9c15>是啊，这次委托也——</color>
——以最楔子的方式了结了！
<color=#8b9c15>啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！我靠，你能不能有一秒钟别打断我说话？！</color>
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
<color=#8b9c15>They gave us some trouble, but—</color>
—verily, once accepted, no contract is beyond us!
<color=#8b9c15>Yeah, this contract was also—</color>
—settled in the Wedgiest fashion!
<color=#8b9c15>ARRRGH!!!!! Holy shit, can you stop cutting me off for one damn second?!</color>

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.zh:
<color=#8b9c15>该死的小混混……我就知道一出事他就会溜之大吉……</color>
唉……这结果早在意料之中，不是吗……？
<color=#8b9c15>啧，别说话……！你流的血要超出保险肯赔的额度了……</color>
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_DonQuixote_Wed.en:
<color=#8b9c15>Damn punk... I knew he'd hightail it the moment shit hit the fan...</color>
Alas... 'twas an expected outcome, was it not...?
<color=#8b9c15>Tsk, don't talk...! You're gonna lose more blood than insurance's willing to cover...</color>

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Sinclair_Wedge.zh: 反正你们这些家伙最后都会被串起来。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Sinclair_Wedge.en: You guys always end up on a skewer, anyway.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Sinclair_Wedge.zh: ……第一遍就听到了！拜托，这次一定得对啊……

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: That old friend left me with quite the troublesome little fellow...

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
正如他所说……你泡双和茶的手艺确实一流。
……要是你在别的方面也能派上用场就好了。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
Just as he said... You certainly are masterful at making a fine cup of ssanghwa-cha.
... Now, if only you could prove useful in any other capacity.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: 人与人互相搭把手，日子会过得更顺，不是吗？不必是什么了不起的举动。出门吃午饭时，给埋头工作的同事带点东西回来。合作，就从学会给别人留这么一点体贴开始。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: Life runs more smoothly when people lend one another a hand, does it not? It need not be some grand gesture. When you step out for lunch, bring something back for the colleague buried in work. Cooperation begins with learning to spare someone that much consideration.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: 已经入夜了吗……？最近我在昏暗中处理委托的时间太长，光是这个时点就足以让我神经紧绷。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: Is it nightfall already...? Lately, I've been spending so much time clearing contracts in the gloom that the hour alone is enough to set my nerves on edge.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: 堂吉诃德。辛克莱。既然有闲工夫盯着那个新手看，想必也能匀出点时间检查装备。老规矩——确认电源能打开，确认挥臂时没有任何卡顿……你们俩现在都该清楚，在战场上，哪怕最微小的疏忽也可能葬送性命。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: Don Quixote. Sinclair. If you have the time to waste gawking at that greenhorn, I'm sure you can spare some for your equipment. You know the drill—check that the power comes on, make sure nothing catches when you swing your arms... You both know by now that the smallest inattention can cost lives on the battlefield.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
你想现在就杀进图书馆，夺回你同事们的书？我可不这么认为。可惜你的判断力还没跟上你在战斗中展现出的潜力。
趁孩子们准备的时候，做几次深呼吸。出发前记住这一点：一旦我看到你的急躁开始在战场上拖我们后腿……第一个被我刺死的就是你。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
You want to storm the Library this instant and reclaim the books of your colleagues? I don't think so. It's a shame your judgment has yet to catch up to what promise you have in combat.
Take a few deep breaths while the kids finish preparing. And remember this before we depart: as soon as I see your impatience starting to trip us up on the battlefield... you'll be the first one I stab dead.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
协会、翼、手指……尽管势力遍及各处，面对扭曲，他们却一样摸不着头脑。就连这一现象与图书馆之间所谓的关联，背后也全是臆测……
嗯……那个扭曲侦探——我本该趁有机会时盘问一下那个可疑的家伙。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
The Associations, the Wings, the Fingers...  For all their reach, they proved to be clueless about what to make of the Distortions. Even the phenomenon's supposed connection to the Library has nothing behind it but guesswork...
Hmm... The Distortion Detective—I should have questioned that suspicious individual while I had the chance.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
……别自作多情了——真正无私的人并不存在。就连自我牺牲，说到底也不过是利己的借口。
你似乎坚信自己是在为事务所着想……那份愚蠢的信念会慢慢侵蚀你的同伴，将他们引向毁灭。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
... Don't flatter yourself—truly selfless people don't exist. Even self-sacrifice is ultimately a self-serving excuse.
You seem utterly convinced that you're acting for the good of your Office... That foolish conviction will slowly eat away at your peers and lead them to damnation.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
那是我第一次亲眼见到马戏团。它们的巢穴神秘莫测，荒凉得令人恐惧，足以让我毛骨悚然。
随后的表演，找不到更好的说法的话，简直就是一场地狱里的庆典——它们的行动毫无固定规律，每一个预判都落了空。我被迫在每个回合重新计算所有可能的结果。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
That was the first time I had ever seen the Circus in person. Their lair was mysterious and terrifyingly bleak, enough to make my skin crawl.
The performance that followed could have passed for a festival in hell, for lack of a better word—their movements followed no specific pattern, and every prediction fell apart. I was forced to run afresh the numbers of possible outcomes at every turn.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: ……难得的清闲，你说？哈。一家没活干的收尾人事务所，可没什么值得高兴的。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: ... A welcome quiet spell, you say? Hah. A Fixer Office starved of work is nothing to be pleased about.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
你还真是慷慨地透露情报啊？面对都市的猎手，这可不是明智的习惯。
已经没有可能的情境需要计算了——只剩迅速而确实的一刺，将你刺穿。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
Rather generous with your intel, aren't you? An unwise habit when facing a hunter of the City.
There are no more possible scenarios left to calculate—just a swift, sure thrust to stab you through.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
喂，孩子们。准备都做好了吧？
<color=#8b9c15>当然。</color>
<color=#ffef23>是，一切妥当！</color>
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
Hey, kids. Preparations complete, I trust?
<color=#8b9c15>Of course.</color>
<color=#ffef23>Aye, 'tis all in order!</color>

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: 性命攸关之际，我们顾不上礼数。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: We can't afford to bother with courtesy when our very lives are at risk.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: 按之前说好的，用手势沟通。保持距离，专注于敌人。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: As discussed, we will communicate by hand signals. Keep your distance and your focus on the enemies.
Tsk. I used to be sharper.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: 这就是你行动迟疑的代价。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: This is the price of your uncertain actions.
... Perhaps the years... have caught up with me, too...
Stabbed right through the heart of it.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: 你就从没想过要先想清楚吗？
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: Did thinking it through never occur to you?

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
已经溜走了吗……8点档马戏团比我预想的还要麻烦。
虽然没能了结此案，但我们已经把这份活儿摸得差不多了。未了的事，改日再算吧。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
They've slipped away already... The 8 o'clock Circus is more trouble than I accounted for.
Couldn't put an end to the case, but we've sized up the job pretty well. Let's settle the outstanding business another day.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh:
看来我的锋芒到底没有退去——到头来，没有一个人是像样的对手。呵……说不定现在我已经胜过我那位老朋友了。
孩子们，书收好了就收尾吧。我们回去了。想打闹，等回了事务所随你们闹。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en:
It seems I haven't lost my edge after all—not one of them proved to be a proper match in the end. Heh... I may even have the better of that old friend of mine by now.
Kids, wrap things up if you're done securing the books. We're heading back. You can scuffle all you like once we're back in the Office.

PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.zh: ……逃生装置起作用了……哈，没想到我竟变得这么心软……看来岁月终于追上我们了……我那位老朋友……和我都是。
PersonalityVoiceDlg/Voice_Outis_Wedge_11.en: ... The escape apparatus worked... Hah, can't believe I've gotten this soft... Guess age finally caught up with us... my old friend... and I both.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 最好别让时间毫无意义地流逝。这里很快就会充满喧嚣与痛苦，但我们不必迟迟不肯接受那必然之事。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: It is best not to let time flow meaninglessly. This place will soon be filled with clamor and suffering, but we need not delay in accepting the inevitable.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 我不希望看到您为员工的死去而痛苦。请放宽心，开始我们的工作吧。只要循环不断重复，我们就永远不会失去任何人。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: I do not wish to see you suffer for the death of your employees. Set your mind at ease, and let us begin our work. We will not ever lose anyone, as long as the cycle repeats.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 局势变得相当不利了。没关系。下次我们换一种方法试试。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: The situation has turned rather unfavorable. That's okay. We will try a different approach next time.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 把您想尝试的一切都试一遍吧。等所有可能性都验证过后，只要重新开始就好。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Attempt everything you have wished to try. Once you have tested all the possibilities, simply begin anew.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 原来，就连那些东西也能被遏止。被迫停滞。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: So, even those things can be brought to a halt. To a standstill.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 看来那名员工的状态不太稳定。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: It appears the employee's state is unstable.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 您一如既往地能干。我会把这份功绩记录下来。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: You are as capable as ever. I shall make a record of that achievement.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 新的员工会来接替逝去的人。这不过是延续不断的循环中又一道刻痕——您无需为此如此痛苦。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: New employees shall come and replace the deceased ones. It is simply another notch in a continuing cycle—there is no need for you to suffer so harshly over it.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 何不就此停下？想必我们并没有真正改变的必要。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Why not just stop here? Surely there is no true need for us to change.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 看来您正遵循着成功的公式。要是我们能永远遵循同一个公式就好了。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: So you are following the formula of success. If only we could follow that same formula indefinitely.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: ……即便如此，您仍要继续前进吗？
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: ... You would still move onward, in spite of everything?

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh:
即使时间的流动被延展至无限，或许我们终究也必然会抵达最后一页。
您会写下最后的那一条记录吗？
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en:
Perhaps it is inevitable that we will reach the final page eventually, even with the flow of time stretched to infinity.
Will you record the final entry?

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 根据记录，死亡会随那一行动的轨迹而至。请务必小心。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: According to the records, death will follow the trails of that action. Please be careful.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 以您的能力，理应能以理性之眼分析这一点并得出结论。请继续吧。我会记录下结果。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: You should be more than capable of analyzing this with the eyes of rationality and arriving at a conclusion. Please proceed. I shall record the outcome.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 该行动与记录相符。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: That action accords with the records.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 您是打算违背记录行事吗？
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Do you mean to act contrary to the records?

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 谨慎而理性的判断。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: A prudent, rational judgment.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: ……过度的谨慎，会化作割伤持刀者的利刃。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: ... Excessive prudence morphs into a knife that cuts its wielder.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 它们是在收容单元的墙外品尝自由的滋味吗？比平时更加难以驾驭了。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Are they savoring their freedom beyond the walls of the containment unit? They have grown all the more unruly than usual.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 抑制正按预期发挥作用。我会将此计入记录与绩效考核。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: The deterrence is functioning as intended. I shall account for this in the records and performance appraisal.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 他们看起来高兴得忘乎所以。或许那些收到我发出的录用通知的人，也曾露出过同样的表情。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: They look quite beside themselves with joy. Perhaps those who received my offer letters once wore that same expression.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 那名员工正四处徘徊，漫无目的地寻找着失去的理智。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: That employee is wandering about, aimlessly searching for the sanity which they have lost.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 有什么东西从您造成的裂缝中涌了出来。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Something spills forth through the crack you've made.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 改变，那破坏性的洪流终究追上了它。既然您在追求改变，或许这样更合您的心意。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: The destructive current of change has eventually caught up to it. Perhaps this is more to your liking, given your pursuit of change.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 恕我直言，我实在不明白您的用意。您还要牺牲多少？您究竟想在这里达成什么？
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: I must say, your intent here eludes me. What more must you sacrifice? What is it that you're trying to achieve here?

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 您看不出何时该停下吗？现在似乎正是最合适的时候。请停下来，和我一起留在这永恒的瞬间里。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Can you not see when it is time to stop? Now seems to be the most apt. Please stop and stay here with me, in this eternal moment.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 这番能干的表现令我相当熟悉。它已成为我难以磨灭的记忆。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: This display of competence is quite familiar. It's become an indelible memory to me.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 或许这一结果是理所当然的；毕竟，是您亲自分配了确切的任务，再由您亲手挑选的员工去执行。但成功有所保证，并不意味着出色的工作就不该得到嘉奖。干得好。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Perhaps this outcome was a given; after all, it was you who assigned the exact task, which was then carried out by an employee you hand-picked. But the guarantee of success does not mean that a job well done should go without commendation. Well done.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 了不起。我会把这名员工的详细情况记入档案，以备您很可能会想再次选用他们。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Remarkable. I will make a note of this employee's particulars in their records, in the likely event that you might wish to select them again.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh: 请品味您的选择与牺牲所结出的果实吧。在忍受了那么久的失去之后……您对自己所达成的一切满意吗？
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en: Savor the fruits of your choices and sacrifices. After all that time spent enduring loss... are you satisfied with the things you have achieved?

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh:
不必执着于无望之事。那么，下次再试一次吧。和我一起。
不知您是否还记得，我一直都站在您这边。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en:
There's no need to cling to lost causes. Now then, let's try again next time. With me.
I'm not sure if you recall, but I've always been on your side.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.zh:
我一直在等您。即便在这里等待着——在这一切都已沉入静止的地方——我也知道您很快就会来。
您可以叫我Hokma。我负责记录并掌控所发生的一切。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Hokma.en:
I've been expecting you. I knew you would come soon, even as I waited here—where everything has sunk into stillness.
You may call me Hokma. I am responsible for recording and controlling everything that occurs.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.zh: 别太紧张，照我们练习的那样做就行。这样我们一定能赢！
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.en: Don't get too nervous, and just do it as we practiced. I'm sure we can win that way!

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.zh: 赢了，我们真的赢了！我做到了。这就说明我也能帮上大家的忙了，对吧？
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.en: We won, we really won! I made it. That means I could be of help to everyone, right?

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.zh: 别责怪自己。我相信你已经尽力了。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.en: Don't blame yourself. I'm sure you did your best.

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.zh: 大家别慌！越是这种时候越要稳住。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.en: Don't panic, everyone! We should keep it together at times like this.
Winning is just gonna be a matter of time!

_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.zh: 好，进展顺利！不过现在高兴还太早了。
_tail/BattleAnnouncerDlg/Announcer_Walpu.en: Yeah, it's going smooth! It's too soon to be rejoicing, though.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 都是熟面孔。那么我们的策略……我想不必多说了。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: All familiar faces. Then our stratagem... I shouldn't have to spell it out.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 我们可不是白当兄弟事务所的。那么……一如既往，拜托你了。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: We aren't sister Offices for nothing. Well... I'll be counting on you, as always.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 那我们最好赶在它之前了结。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: Then we'd do well to finish before it does.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 突入路线已确保。全员，准备冲击交锋！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: Entry route secured. All units, engage for collision!
The least I can do is bear responsibility.
Sheesh, stop telling me what to do!
Fine, you wanna have a go at it, yeah?
... Can't you just stick to one?
... I'm not gonna care—I really won't.
Heh. I like the sound of that!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 劳驾，现在掩护吾的后方！
……这次连脑袋都被碾得无可挽回了……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.en: ... Even the head hath been crushed beyond salvaging this time...
I shall clear the way forth!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#85SV-06.zh: 迅速而确实的一刺，将你刺穿。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#85SV-06.en: A swift, sure thrust to stab you through.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg.json#battle_.zh: 已贯穿。现在，挣扎着触电吧。

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: ……于破晓时分。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: ... At the crack of dawn.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 太阳很快就要升起了。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: The sun will rise, soon.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 喂！这种事交给前辈们，听到没？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Hey! Leave this sort of thing to your seniors, got that?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 呵……这才是我们事务所的骄傲。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Heh... There's the pride of our Office.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 别指望能全身而退。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Don't expect to get away scot-free.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 辛苦了，尤娜。安心休息吧——我们事务所不会有事的。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Thank you for your service, Yuna. You can rest easy—our Office will be fine.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 看来还是太勉强了……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I suppose it was still too much...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 我对你的勇气深表敬意。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I pay much respect to your courage.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 如蝴蝶振翅。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Like a butterfly beating its wings.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 如蝴蝶展翅。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Like a butterfly unfurling its wings.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 反应射出。将所有目标切割成块。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Reactive ejection. Sectioning every target into pieces.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 让我来协助吧。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Allow me to assist.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 趁对手开始进攻前，先发制人吧。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Let's strike first before the opponents start attacking.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 菲利普和事务所就交给我照看了……安息吧，老爷子。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I’ll take care of Philip and the Office for you... Rest in peace, gramps.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 希望他一个人也能好好的……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I hope he can do fine by himself...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 你还不算太差，只是没能把本事发挥出来。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: You weren't too bad, but you couldn’t capitalize on your skills.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 就用这烙印……给你打上印记。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: With this stigma... I'll brand you.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 这种情况下我根本撑不住……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: There's no way I can hold out in a situation like this...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 不……不可能……真是出乎意料。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: No... It can't be... This is unexpected.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 这种情况下，毫不犹豫地攻击才是正解，对吧……？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Striking without hesitation is the answer in situations like this, right...?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 这……应该是正解吧……？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: This... should be the answer, right...?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 这次不会和上次一样……我不想逃。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: It won't be the same as the last... I don't want to run.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: ……我必须高高飞起。飞向那耀眼的太阳，飞向更高的天空！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: ... I have to soar high. Toward that radiant sun, toward skies higher still!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 又只剩我一个人了……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I'm left alone again...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 我没能帮上忙……我……又害怕了……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I couldn't help... I... got afraid again...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 是啊……我只是需要再大胆一点。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Yeah... I just needed to be more daring.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 这次我一定要结束这场战斗。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I'll end this fight for sure this time.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 只为了悲伤的我自己……火焰啊，为我明亮地哭泣吧！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: For my grieving self alone... Cry bright, flames, for me!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 等等……为什么……我还必须把这件事做完！！！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Wait... Why... I still have to finish this!!!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 犹豫无法让我前进。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Hesitation won't help me move forward.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 那身衣服……怎么会……？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: That outfit... How...?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 已贯穿。现在，挣扎着触电吧。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Punctured. Now, writhe and jolt.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 已贯穿。现在，挣扎着触电吧。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Punctured. Now, writhe and jolt.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 我最好再快一点。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I better speed up a smidge.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 喂，孩子们。准备好老一套。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Hey, kids. Get ready for the usual.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 喂，孩子们。准备好老一套。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Hey, kids. Get ready for the usual.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 放电！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Spark!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 放电！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Spark!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 我至少能承担起责任。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: The least I can do is bear responsibility.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 这一切都可以归咎于个人的疏忽，不是吗？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: It can all be attributed to the inattention of the individual, no?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 我三番五次警告过你，要注意正面……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: I warned you time after time to watch your front...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: ……真不该接下这么个麻烦的小家伙。看来只能自己泡的茶自己喝了。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: ... Shouldn't have taken on such a troublesome little fellow. Suppose I'll drink as I brewed.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 行动迟疑的下场就是死亡。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: The consequence of uncertain actions is death.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 哈……你就不能先操心好你自己的活儿吗？！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Hah... Why don't you worry about your job?!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 冲击！！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Collision!!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 别再跟我找茬了，专心捅穿敌人行不行？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Quit picking fights with me and focus on skewering the enemy, huh?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: ……这情况挺棘手的，但我得挺过去。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: ... This is a pretty tough situation, but I gotta get over it.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 哼，谁让她那么嚣张。……我才不会在意，真的不会。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Hmph, that's what she gets for being cheeky. ... I'm not gonna care, I really won't.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 以为我会输给你这种家伙？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Thought I'd lose to the likes of you?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 真不该让那个该死的小混混跟着……
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Shouldn't have allowed that damn punk to tag along...

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 你碍着我了，待在你自己的位置上。想跟你的身体告别两次吗？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: You’re getting in my way, so stay to your position. Wanna say goodbye to your body twice?

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: ……冲击！
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: ... Collision!

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 拜托别再惹上次那样的麻烦了。你该知道那有多费事。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Please don't get into the same trouble as last time. You should know how much of a hassle it is.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 感觉不太妙……我们得提高警惕。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: This doesn't feel good... We should be on our toes.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 干我们这行，这本就是该预料到的事。
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: It's what we should always expect when we do work like this.

_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.zh: 好了，还剩几个？
_root/BattleSpeechBubbleDlg-walpu10.json.en: Alright, how many more left?

_tail/MainUIText-a1c10p1.json#gacha_307_.zh:
楔子事务所收尾人 堂吉诃德与楔子事务所收尾人 辛克莱在提取中视为同一个3★人格。获得其中任意一个人格时，必定同时获得另一个。

· 楔子事务所收尾人 堂吉诃德 & 楔子事务所收尾人 辛克莱的提取概率如下：
  - 以该组合为3★目标的定向提取中：与1个3★目标人格的出现概率相同
  - 其他可能出现该组合的提取中：与1个非目标3★人格的出现概率相同
（详细概率请参阅各提取的[概率]）

· 星芒也按该组合为同一个3★人格计算。首次通过提取获得时，两个人格合计获得300星芒。

· 在两个人格均为3★目标的定向提取中，可消耗200[理想]同时兑换两者。

· 两个人格均已拥有后再次获得该组合时，将获得当前赛季的堂吉诃德自我碎片25个与辛克莱自我碎片25个，以代替该稀有度重复人格通常给予的自我碎片。

· 该组合加入自动贩卖机后，可消耗堂吉诃德与辛克莱的自我碎片合计400个同时获得两个人格。每名罪人的自我碎片至少须使用1个，两者的比例可自由调整。

· 人格升级、同步与外观投影需对每个人格分别进行。每个人格所需材料与普通3★人格相同。强化所需的自我碎片须为对应罪人的碎片。
_tail/MainUIText-a1c10p1.json#gacha_307_.en:
Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote and Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair are treated as a single 3★ Identity in the Extraction. Obtaining either Identity will always yield the other in the pair.

· The Extraction rates for Wedge Office Fixer Don Quixote & Wedge Office Fixer Sinclair are as follows:
  - In Target Extractions where the pair is featured as the 3★ pickup: The same appearance rate as 1 featured 3★ Identity
  - In all other Extractions where the pair can appear: The same appearance rate as 1 non-featured 3★ Identity
(for detailed rates, please refer to [Probabilities] for each Extraction)

· Starlight is also calculated as if the pair were a single 3★ Identity. When first obtained through Extraction, the two Identities grant a combined total of 300 Starlight.

· In Target Extractions where both Identities are featured as the 3★ pickup, both can be exchanged together for 200 Yisang [Ideality].

· If the pair is obtained again after both Identities have already been acquired, you will receive 25 Don Quixote Egoshards and 25 Sinclair Egoshards from the current Season instead of the usual Egoshards awarded for duplicate Identities of their rarity.

· Once the pair is added to the Dispenser, both Identities can be obtained together for a combined total of 400 Don Quixote and Sinclair Egoshards. You must use at least 1 Egoshard from each Sinner, but you can adjust the ratio between the two freely.

· Identity level-ups, Upties, and Façade Projection must be performed separately for each Identity. Each Identity requires the same materials as a standard 3★ Identity. Any Egoshards required for these upgrades must belong to the respective Sinner.

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh:
这把以未能守住的誓言磨砺的剑……
……想必懂得比任何人都深的悲伤……
……已无人可共担这份哀愁。
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en:
This sword, sharpened with unkept vows...
... must know a grief deeper than any other...
... with no one left to share the sorrow.

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh: 这把以未能守住的誓言磨砺的剑……
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en: This sword, sharpened with unkept vows...

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh: 想必懂得比任何人都深的悲伤……
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en: Must know a grief deeper than any other...

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh: 已无人可共担这份哀愁。
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en: With no one left to share the sorrow.

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh: 我会与你分担你的哀愁……
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en: I'll share the burden of your sorrow...

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh: 再以这些褪色的誓言将它系紧……
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en: And bind it with these weathered vows...

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh: 愿它沉入心灵的最深处……
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en: May it sink to the profundities of the heart...

_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.zh:
未能守住的誓言……还有褪色的骄傲……
就让它们全都凝结、消散吧。
_tail/EGOVoiceDig/Voice_EGO_HongLu_6.jso.en:
The vows that could not be upheld... and the weathered pride...
Let them all curdle and fade away.

_tail/EGOgift_walpu10.json#9292#desc.zh:
若编队中有不少于2名“收尾人”人格，则对出战顺序最靠后的1名“收尾人”友方单位(不包括待命人员)触发以下效果：
- 首次进入战斗时，获得[Emulation]

回合开始时，场上每有2名友方“收尾人”人格，使友方“收尾人”人格恢复2点理智值

若场上有不少于3名属于同一阵营的“收尾人”人格，则触发以下效果：
- 带有[Emulation]的友方单位的基础攻击技能造成的伤害+(场上“收尾人”友方单位数×3)%(最多+15%)

若场上有不少于3名属于不同阵营的“收尾人”人格，则触发以下效果：
- 带有[Emulation]的友方单位使用基础攻击技能时，使该友方单位获得1层[Enhancement](每回合最多2次)
- 带有[Emulation]的友方单位使用基础攻击技能命中时，对目标施加1层[Vulnerable](每回合最多2次；集中遭遇战，仅该部位)
_tail/EGOgift_walpu10.json#9292#desc.en:
If there are 2 or more "Fixer" Identities in the Team Loadout, activate the following effect for 1 "Fixer" ally with the lattermost Deployment Order (excluding Backup units):
- Upon entering the Encounter for the first time, gain [Emulation]

Turn Start: Allied "Fixer" Identities heal 2 SP for every 2 allied "Fixer" Identities on the field

If there are 3 or more "Fixer" Identities of the same faction on the field, activate the following effect:
- Base Attack Skills of allies that have [Emulation] deal +(# of "Fixer" allies on the field x 3)% damage (max 15%)

If there are 3 or more "Fixer" Identities of different factions on the field, activate the following effect:
- On Base Attack Skill Use by an ally that has [Emulation], the said ally gains 1 [Enhancement] (2 times per turn)
- On Hit using a Base Attack Skill by an ally that has [Emulation], inflict 1 [Vulnerable] (2 times per turn; in Focused Encounters, the Part)

_tail/EGOgift_walpu10.json#9293#desc.zh:

Attack Skills additionally triggered by Skills that have the [ComboSkill] effect or triggered by allies' Skill / Passive effects deal +10% damage
- Deal an additional +2% damage every time the above effect activates (max 10%)
- For Skills that have the [ComboSkill] effect, gain 1 [AttackDmgUp] every time the said Skills are used (max 2 per Identity)
- If the ally is a "<noparse>Dawn Office</noparse>" or "<noparse>Wedge Office</noparse>" Identity, the said ally gains 1 [Enhancement] (max 2 per Identity)

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 第10次 瓦尔普吉斯之夜
第10次 瓦尔普吉斯之夜
[第10次 瓦尔普吉斯之夜] 不论您的主线故事进度，都将解锁。您可以通过玻璃窗或驾驶席上的活动横幅进入。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: [The 10th Walpurgis Night] unlocks regardless of your progress in the Main Story. Enter via the event banner on the Window or the Driverside tabs.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 第10次 瓦尔普吉斯之夜的活动持续时间显示在这里。活动期间内，完成简单及困难难度的战斗任务，可以领取任务奖励。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: The duration of The 10th Walpurgis Night event is shown here. During the event, complete Missions for Easy and Hard difficulty event Encounters and claim their rewards.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 选择这扇门可进入简单难度战斗。进入战斗时会消耗脑啡肽模块。简单难度下，65级以下的出战人格等级将被自动提升至65。并且，出战人格的同步阶段与E.G.O的异想解析阶段若是低于3，将被自动提升至3阶段。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: Select the door to begin the Easy difficulty Encounter. The Encounter consumes Enkephalin Module upon entry. On Easy difficulty, any Deployed Identities under Level 65 will be raised to Level 65. Also, any Deployed Identities and E.G.O under Tier 3 Uptie/Threadspinning Level will be raised to Tier 3 Uptie/Threadspinning Level.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 通过简单难度将解锁困难难度。在困难难度下，人格的等级、同步阶段与E.G.O异想解析阶段将保持不变。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: Clearing the Easy difficulty Encounter unlocks the Hard difficulty. In Hard difficulty, your Identities' current Levels, Uptie Tiers, and E.G.O Threadspinning Tiers will be reflected.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 在编队界面中以第一顺位出战的罪人将被赋予“指定司书[历史层]”效果。拥有“指定司书[历史层]”效果的罪人将获得额外行动槽，并获得其他增益。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: The #1 Sinner to be deployed in the Teams menu will be imbued with the "Patron Librarian [Floor of History]" effect. The Sinner with the "Patron Librarian [Floor of History]" effect will gain more Slots and other beneficial effects.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 通过[任务列表]界面，能够查看需要完成的任务，以及任务奖励。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: You can enter the [Missions] page, where you can view the list of Missions to be completed during the Encounter and their rewards.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: [任务列表]界面将显示奖励领取期。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: You can view the Reward Exchange period in the [Missions] page.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 能够分别确认简单及困难任务。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: Easy difficulty and Hard difficulty each has different sets of Missions to complete.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 完成任务可在[任务列表]领取多样化奖励。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: Complete these Missions and claim various rewards from the [Missions] page.

_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.zh: 活动结束后，您也依然可以通过驾驶席及放映室-[外传故事]，随时重温“第10次 瓦尔普吉斯之夜”的关卡和故事。
_tail/Walpu10EventText.json#tutorial_mai.en: Even after the event fully ends, you will be able to experience the "The 10th Walpurgis Night" combat Encounters and view its story anytime at the Driverside and Theater - [Detour Tales].

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112101#eve.zh:
“喂，喂。看看这里这段。”
“要点3：竖起衣领能对对手产生威慑效果。”

穿着不合身大衣的收尾人用指尖划过杂志上的访谈，解释道。

“所以我就照着这里的建议……做成了这样。”

“怎么样？感受到威慑了吗？”

……这到底该从哪儿说起？更重要的是，谁去告诉他？
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112101#eve.en:
"Hey, hey. Look at this part over here."
"Point #3: Popping your collar will have an intimidating effect on your opponent."

The Fixer in the ill-fitting coat explained, tracing a line from the interview in the magazine with his fingertip.

"So I followed the advice right here... just like this."

"How's that? Feeling intimidated?"

... Where should we even begin? More importantly, who's going to tell him?

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112101#fai.zh:
{0}盯着照片看了很久很久，然后开口了。

“首先，把衣领再竖高一点……”

“这样？”

“呃，我还是没看出那个味儿。要不试试把袖子挽起来。”

“你确定问题出在这儿？你看，他是用右手拿武器的。”

“可我是左撇子。”

“嗯！依吾之见，这正是锻炼双手并用之技的绝妙良机！”

年轻的收尾人和罪人们凑在一起商量该怎么办，但无论从哪个方向着手，讨论似乎总会绕回原点。

“那个……谢谢你们想帮忙，真的，但是……这样真的行不通啊，各位。我还是自己琢磨吧。谢谢你们。”

“真是个倔脾气的混蛋，是吧？……啊，抱歉。白白浪费了你们的时间。”

……穿着不合身大衣的收尾人走远了，一路上脸都埋在那本杂志里。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112101#fai.en:
{0} stared at the photo for a long, long time, then began.

"First, pop your collar some more..."

"Like this?"

"Ehh, I ain't seein' the vision. Maybe try rollin' up those sleeves."

"Are ya sure that's the problem here? Look, he's holding the weapon in his right hand."

"But I'm left-handed."

"Hm! Then I daresay 'tis an opportunity most wonderful to cultivate thy skill in the field of ambidextrousness!"

The young Fixer and the Sinners all came together to contemplate what to do, but no matter which direction we tackled it from, the discussion seemed to return to square one.

"So... I appreciate you trying to help, I really do, but... this really isn't working out, guys. I'll just try to figure it out on my own. Thanks for trying."

"Stubborn bastard, isn't he? ... Ah, I'm sorry. I've wasted your time for nothing."

... The Fixer in the ill-fitting coat walked away, his face buried in that magazine all the way.

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112101#suc.zh: “呃，可是这里写着……” {0}指出了访谈里的另一句话。 “所有优秀的收尾人都必须遵守的两条规则：” “第一，别做模仿者。” “第二，无论如何都要遵守第一条。” “……” “……你看，关键在于要有自己的风格，懂吧？” “好像是有道理……我是想成为像他那样的人，不是真的变成同一个人……” 穿着不合身大衣的收尾人郑重地琢磨了一会儿这两条规则，随后挽起了那件过大的大衣的袖子。 “谢谢。看来我一直都忽略了真正重要的东西。” 两名收尾人笑着离开了，仿佛卸下了肩上的重担。 “等等，你们忘了杂——” 那本杂志早已被翻得破旧，一页又一页满是画线和标记的句子，但那个年轻的收尾人似乎已经不再需要它了。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112101#suc.en: "Uh, but here, it says..." {0} pointed out another phrase from the interview. "Two rules all excellent Fixers must abide by:" "First, don't be a copycat." "Second, follow the first rule no matter what." "......." "... Look, it's all about being original, see?" "I guess you have a point... I want to be like him, not actually be the same person..." The Fixer in the ill-fitting coat gravely contemplated the two rules for a moment, then rolled up the sleeves of the oversized coat. "Thanks. It seems that I've been neglecting what's really important all along." The two Fixers walked away, smiling like a weight had been lifted from their shoulders. "Wait, you forgot the mag—" The magazine was well-worn with pages upon pages of underlined and highlighted phrases, but it seemed that the young Fixer no longer had any need for it.

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#beh.zh: 由谁来试着煮一杯双和茶？
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#beh.en: Who will try brewing a cup of ssanghwa-cha?

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#eve.zh:
我们连个解释都没有就闯进了人家的事务所，实在没法心安理得地坐着喝茶。
况且我们有十来个人，那个茶壶根本装不下够这么多客人喝的茶。
我们小心翼翼地提议，由我们自己来煮一壶双和茶。

“你们想自己煮……？”

戴眼镜的收尾人来回看了看我们和茶壶，然后……

“我自己来倒也无所谓……不过，行吧。试试看。”

……退到一旁，示意我们去茶壶那边。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#eve.en:
There was no way we could be comfortable sitting around and sipping from teacups when we'd just barged into this guy's office without an explanation.
Besides, there were about a dozen of us, and the teapot was nowhere near large enough to hold enough tea for so many guests.
We gingerly suggested brewing our own batch of ssanghwa-cha.

"You want to brew your own batch...?"

The glasses-wearing Fixer looked back and forth between us and the teapot, then...

"I don't really mind doing it myself, but... sure. Give it a try."

... moved to the side, gesturing us toward the pot.

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#fai.zh:
我们只移开视线几秒钟，可这几秒钟就足够让茶壶里冒出一股刺鼻的焦糊味了。

“啊啊，得把火调小啊！”

尽管我们手忙脚乱地关小了火，事务所里还是已经弥漫着一股难闻的焦糊味。

“哎呀，这双和茶的味道我都闻腻了——搞什么？什么东西着火了？”

一名背着大箱子的收尾人走进事务所，打开窗户散味。

“哈哈哈。不如就此打住，让我们好好招待各位客人吧？”

老人示意我们坐下，似乎并不在意我们给他的事务所添的乱。
……不过他是不是真的不在意，我们永远也不会知道了……

过了一会儿，一杯新茶摆在了我们面前。是老人亲手煮的。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#fai.en:
We only looked away for a few seconds, but a few seconds was all it needed for an acrid smell of something burning to rise from the teapot.

"Ahh, you've got to reduce the heat!"

Despite our mad scramble to lower the heat, the Office was already filled with an unpleasant, burning stench.

"Eugh, I'm sick of this smell of ssanghwa— What the hell? Did something catch fire?"

A Fixer carrying a large trunk on her back walked into the Office and opened the windows to get the smell out.

"Ha ha ha. Why don't you all stop while you're ahead and let us treat you as guests?"

The old man gestured for us to sit, seemingly unconcerned about the mess we'd brought upon his office.
... Though we'll never know if he truly was unconcerned...

A little while later, a fresh cup of tea was set before us. The old man had brewed it himself.

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#suc.zh:
我们按照那位年轻收尾人讲解的顺序放入材料。
水烧到翻滚沸腾时，我们调小了火，让材料慢慢地熬煮。
我们这位临时的茶艺老师好几次张嘴像是要插话，但最后还是安静地在一旁看着。

双和茶煮好后，我们把它倒进杯中，又小心地在上面放了一颗鲜黄的蛋黄。

“哦……不得不说，看起来像模像样的。”

简短地夸了一句之后，那位老人喝了一口我们煮的双和茶……然后点了点头，嘴角露出慈祥的微笑。

“你们确定这是第一次煮吗？哈哈。”

或许是光线的错觉，但我觉得自己看到那位戴眼镜的收尾人微微皱了皱眉。

“……要不要把我们剩下的材料带一些回去？我给你们写张配比的字条，回家试着煮煮看。”

他递给我们一个包装得一丝不苟的袋子，里面有处理得十分到位的材料，还有从配比、火候一直到倒进杯中的每一步详细说明。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112201#suc.en:
We added the ingredients in the order explained to us by the young Fixer.
When the water came to a rolling boil, we reduced the heat, letting the ingredients simmer gently.
Our impromptu tea instructor opened his mouth a few times as if to interject, but he eventually settled into quiet observation.

With the batch of ssanghwa-cha completed, we poured it into a cup and carefully placed a bright yellow egg yolk on top.

"Ohh... I must say, this does look the part."

After that brief compliment, the old man took a sip of our ssanghwa-cha... and nodded, his lips drawn into a kindly smile.

"Are you sure this is the first batch you've ever brewed? Haha."

Perhaps it was a trick of the light, but I think I saw the slightest hint of a frown on the glasses-wearing Fixer.

"... Why don't you take some of our leftover ingredients with you? I'll give you a note with the mixing ratio on it, so try making some at home."

He handed us a meticulously packaged bag, complete with expertly prepared ingredients and detailed instructions on every step of the brewing process, from the mixing ratio and heat controls, all the way down to pouring it into a cup.

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#beh.zh: 由哪位罪人接受骑士的加护？
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#beh.en: Which Sinner should receive the knight's blessing?

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#eve.zh: 骑士伸出一只手。在那冰冷的触感之下，涌来一股难以承受的悲伤。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#eve.en: The knight extends a hand. Beneath the chill of her touch comes a wave of sorrow too great to bear.

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#fai.zh:
“要是……什么都没有留下就好了……”
刺骨的寒意爬过{0}的皮肤。
没过多久，它便化作一片漆黑的悲伤，吞没了其内心。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#fai.en:
"If only... nothing had been left behind..."
A biting cold creeps across {0}'s skin.
Before long, it becomes a dark sorrow and engulfs their heart.

_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#suc.zh:
一股悲伤缓缓漫过{0}。
骑士的手触碰过的地方，残留着深深的寒意。
这留下的会是骄傲还是绝望，尚未可知。
_tail/AbEvents-walpu10.json#97112301#suc.en:
A wave of sorrow slowly washes over {0}.
A deep chill lingers where the knight's hand touched them.
Whether this will leave them with pride or despair remains to be seen.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#d.zh: 我看见两个年轻的收尾人缩在一条窄得令人窒息的街角尽头，一起埋头翻看一本杂志。 其中一人穿着一件长大衣，看起来至少是为身高两倍于他的人做的。他拼命摆弄衣摆，想让它看起来稍微合身一点，那模样实在滑稽。 “我看起来怎么样？有那味儿了吗？” “有那个收尾人的山寨版那味儿了吧，大概。相信我，兄弟。衣服能给人加的分是有限的，哪怕是他穿的那种大衣。” “啧……真的吗？不过至少能让我觉得自己很帅吧……当收尾人不就是靠这种心态嘛……？” 另一个收尾人讥讽地哼了一声，随后凑到我们跟前，大声地说起了悄悄话。 “哎，在这儿碰到真正的收尾人可太好了。你们是收尾人吧？至少看着挺像的。能不能过来劝劝他？这可怜的家伙已经用一百种不同的方式竖了30分钟衣领了。”
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#d.en: I saw two young Fixers huddled at the end of a stiflingly narrow street corner, poring over a magazine together. One of them wore a long coat that seemed made for someone at least twice his height. It was a comical sight, him fussing with the hems in a desperate bid to make them look remotely fitting. "How do I look? Getting there?" "Getting to look like a parody of that Fixer, maybe. Trust me, dude. There's only so much clothes can do to make the man, even if it's the same kind of coat he wears." "Tsk... Really? Still, it should at least help me feel badass... And what's being a Fixer if not all about that mindset...?" The other Fixer let out a sarcastic snort, then leaned toward us and whispered loudly. "Boy, am I glad to see some real Fixers out here. You are Fixers, right? At least you do look the part. Why don't you come talk some sense into him? Poor guy's been popping the collar in a hundred different ways for the last 30 minutes."

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#o.zh: 给年轻的收尾人一些真诚的建议。
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#o.en: Give the young Fixer some genuine tips.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#o.zh: 怠惰优势判定 成功时，获得1件泛用E.G.O饰品
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#o.en: Sloth Advantage check. Pass to gain a Keywordless E.G.O Gift.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#o.zh:
“呃……大衣挺酷的，兄弟。”

“可、可真看不出来。它……就像给你量身定做的一样。”

听到夸奖，年轻的收尾人开心得眉开眼笑。

“是吧？那再看看这个。我就这么随随便便地把武器往肩上一扛……砰！我看起来怎么样？”

……他看起来像个拼命想模仿漫画里那种雕像般角色的小孩子。

我们来回对比着他的尝试和杂志封面上的收尾人，渐渐意识到两者之间的差距不只在于衣着；那是某种形而上层面的东西——是“气场”的问题。

被迫看了一阵这场个人时装秀之后，罪人们的耐心一点点被消磨殆尽，终于有人决定开口了。

“恕吾冒昧，年轻的先生——汝定是在尝试名为‘cosplay’的技艺吧？嗯……诚然，吾承认某些生理上的差异是无法复制的；唉，吾仍坚持认为，汝该找一件更衬汝身材的大衣……”

“是啊，伙计。绝对的。穿着那破玩意儿逛上一个礼拜，用不了多久你就能上杂志了。别问我是哪个版面。”

“……你们都好过分。”

收尾人气呼呼地大步离开了，一路拖着那件长大衣。

“*咳咳* 我想坦诚地谈一谈……也算是一种办法吧。抱歉浪费了你们的时间。”
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971121#o.en:
"Uh... Cool coat, my guy."

"Could've, um, fooled me. It... fits you like a tailored suit."

The young Fixer beamed happily at the compliments.

"Sure does, doesn't it? Now check this out. I'm gonna rest this weapon on my shoulder all nonchalant like this... and bam! How do I look?"

... He looks like a small child desperately trying to look like a statuesque comic book character.

As we looked back and forth between his supposed attempt and the cover Fixer on the magazine, it slowly began to dawn on us that the difference between them was more than just sartorial; it was something on the metaphysical realm—it was a matter of "energy."

Being forced to sit through this one-man fashion show for a while slowly eroded away at the Sinners' patience until some of them finally decided to speak up.

"If I might ask, young sir—thou must be engaged in an attempt at the art of 'cosplay,' indeed? Hmm... Forsooth, I concede that certain physiological disparities cannot be replicated; alas, I insist that thou seekest a coat that may better complement thy stature..."

"Yeah, mate. Totally. Go 'round wearin' that shite for a week, and you'll get your own story in the magazines in no time. Don't ask me which section."

"... You're all so mean."

The Fixer huffed and strode away from us, dragging that long coat behind him all the way.

"*cough* I guess an honest conversation... could be an approach. Sorry about wasting your time."

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971122#d.zh: 被一股神秘而宜人的微苦香气吸引，我们在一块写着“黎明事务所”的招牌下停住了脚步。 走进去后，我们看见一位老人靠在沙发上翻阅文件，一个戴眼镜的年轻人正小心翼翼地把一杯热气腾腾的茶放到他面前。 “嗯……是来委托的吗？” “啊，我想你们是被香味吸引过来的吧。这茶的香气相当宜人，对吧？我们煮得足够大家喝，别客气，喝上一两杯吧。” “可不够这里的所有人喝啊，师父……” 戴眼镜的收尾人担忧地瞥了茶壶一眼。 “那就请喝我的吧。毕竟客人优先。”
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971122#d.en: Lured by a mysterious, pleasantly bitter scent, we stopped beneath a sign that read "Dawn Office." When we stepped inside, we saw an old man lounging on a couch, reading through papers, while a young man in glasses carefully set a steaming teacup in front of him. "Hmm... Are you here for a contract?" "Ah, I suppose you were drawn here by the smell. This tea has quite a pleasant aroma, doesn't it? We've brewed more than enough for everyone, so don't hesitate to take a cup or two." "Not enough for everyone here, Master..." The Fixer in glasses gave the pot a concerned glance. "Then please, have mine. Guests come first, after all."

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971122#o.en: Select to heal HP & SP for all allies

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971122#o.zh:
捧着茶杯的双手传来令人安心的暖意。
起初的苦味让罪人们一时皱起了脸，但每喝一口，都会留下一丝温和的回甘。

等我们喝光杯中的茶时，不知不觉间绷紧的肩膀终于放松了下来。

“忙碌并不是坏事，但也要允许自己喝杯好茶，稍事歇息。”
“每个人都需要放松一下的时候，嗯？”

老人身体力行着自己的建议，在我们喝茶的期间，一次也没有问过我们为何而来。
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971122#o.en:
Comforting warmth spread through the hands that cradled the teacups.
The Sinners' faces briefly scrunched up at the initial bitterness, but a gentle sweetness lingered after each sip.

By the time we emptied our cups, our shoulders—which had tensed up without us realizing—had finally relaxed.

"There's nothing wrong with keeping busy, but allow yourselves a brief respite with a nice cup of tea."
"Everyone needs a moment to unwind, hm?"

Following his own advice, the old man never once asked what had brought us there as we drank our tea.
Brew our own batch of ssanghwa-cha.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971123#d.zh:
在一条幽暗通道的尽头，一名孤身的骑士站在一把泛着蓝光的剑旁。

我们走近时，骑士默默地打量着我们的伤口，随后伸出了一只手。

“原来……还有需要守护的东西啊。”

伸出的那只手上萦绕着无底的悲伤，而悬浮在一旁的剑尖仿佛浸透了无尽的绝望。
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971123#d.en:
At the end of a dark passage, a lone knight stands beside a sword glowing blue.

As we approach, the knight silently regards our wounds before extending a hand.

"So... there is still something left to protect."

A bottomless sorrow hangs about the offered hand, while the tip of the sword floating nearby seems steeped in endless despair.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971123#o.zh:
“这把剑……”

骑士轻轻将手放在我们献上的剑刃上。一滴冰冷漆黑的泪从她眼中落下，渗入了剑锋。

“一把……以永远无法守住的誓言锻造、磨砺而成的剑……”
“我所剩下的只有这份空洞的自尊了……但请收下吧……”

我们从骑士手中接过剑。一股深不可测的绝望顺着握剑的手臂爬了上来。
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971123#o.en:
"This sword..."

The Knight gently lays a hand upon the blade we offer. A droplet of cold, black tear falls from her eye and seeps into its edge.

"A sword... forged and sharpened from vows that could never be kept..."
"All I have left is this hollow pride... but please, take it..."

We accept the sword from the Knight. An unfathomable despair creeps up the arm that holds it.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971124#d.zh: 一扇典雅的老式门上挂着写有“楔子事务所”的招牌。 我们小心地敲了敲门，两名个子小小的收尾人开门接待了我们。 “你们是来给我们委托的？” “哪有这么跟来访者说话的？你该更有礼貌一点。” “哦，别来这套。那你想让我怎么说？” “请问各位是来委托业务的吗？” “……这怎么就更‘有礼貌’了？” “这叫‘职业用语’。你怎么能这么无知？” 就在这两名看似双胞胎的收尾人互相拌嘴时，一个穿着整洁黑色大衣的男人从里屋走出来迎接我们。 “我们应该没见过。你们看上去不像是来委托的客户……是来找工作的吗？”
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971124#d.en: A sign reading "Wedge Office" hangs over an elegant, old-fashioned door. We knock cautiously, and two petite Fixers answered the door and received us. "You guys here to give us a contract?" "Is that any way to address a visitor? You should be more polite." "Oh, don't start. What do you want me to say?" "May I ask if you guys are here to commission a contract?" "... How's that supposed to be more 'polite'?" "It's called 'professional tone.' How ignorant can you be?" As the two Fixers, seemingly twins, bicker with each other, a man in a neat black coat emerges from the back room to greet us. "I don't believe we've met. You don't look like clients with a request... Are you looking for work?"

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971124#o.zh:
“你们想和我们共事？”

他打量了我们一会儿，然后缓缓摇了摇头。

“你们看起来很能打，但光凭外表，我没法判断你们的战局分析与决断能力。”

“我想你们暂时还没法和我们步调一致。”

“不过，我们的兄弟事务所或许更适合你们。”

他从书桌抽屉里取出一条白色领巾递给我们。

“把这个带去黎明事务所。比起我们，他们更看重战斗能力。”

他站起身，和另外两名收尾人一起把我们送出门。

“或许哪天我们还会再见。”
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971124#o.en:
"You want to work with us?"

He studies us for a moment, then slowly shakes his head.

"You look capable in a fight, but I have no way of judging your battle analysis and decision-making skills just by looking at you."

"I doubt you could work in step with us just yet."

"Our sister Office might be a better fit, though."

He takes a white cravat from his desk drawer and hands it to us.

"Take this to Dawn Office. They value fighting ability more than we do."

He rises and sees us out with the other two Fixers.

"Perhaps we'll meet again someday."

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971124#o.zh:
他挨个打量了我们一遍，然后带着一丝怀疑问道。

“是哪家兄弟事务所？”

我们一犹豫，他的神情便更加狐疑了。就在这时……

“是、是黎明事务所！”

“哦？萨尔瓦多可没提过招了新人。”

“诚、诚然，那是——呃……”

猝不及防之下，我们的回答结结巴巴，拼命把所知道的一切拼凑起来，好把自己伪装成黎明事务所的新人。

“……原来如此。我想我明白了。”

他站起身，从衣帽架上取下一顶黑色帽子递给我们。

“你们对收尾人事务所确实做足了功课。”

“不过给你们一个建议：下次有人问起，别那么费尽心思地解释。那只会让你们听起来更可疑。”

“我跟你说，我刚才一直在拼命憋笑。”

“撒谎也是需要练习的哦。”

我们接过帽子走了出去。门刚一关上，里面就爆发出一阵笑声。
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971124#o.en:
He looks us over one by one, then asks with a hint of suspicion.

"Which sister Office would that be?"

We hesitate, and his expression grows more doubtful. Then...

"'Tis D-Dawn Office!"

"Oh? Salvador didn't mention taking on any new hires."

"V-verily, that's—uh..."

Caught off guard, we stumbled through our answers, desperately piecing together whatever we knew to pass ourselves off as Dawn Office rookies.

"... I see. I believe I understand now."

He gets up, takes a black hat from the coat rack, and offers it to us.

"You certainly did your homework on Fixer Offices."

"But a word of advice: next time someone asks, don't go quite so far out of your way to explain yourself. It only makes you sound suspicious."

"I'm telling you, I was trying not to burst out laughing."

"Lies need practice too, you know."

We take the hat and step outside. As soon as the door closes, laughter erupts from within.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971125#d.zh:
在一条小巷里的柜台前，两名身高相差悬殊的收尾人正在和一名职员争执。

“那可是干净利落的一刀，懂吗？我们是在整件事处理完之后才把脑袋捡回来的。”

“我亲爱的先生，您真以为我们会为了骗保，去花钱买那么昂贵的停滞保存包装吗？”

“根据保单条款，你们还需要回去把躯干也找回来，我们才能——”

“哦，拜托。你不是认真的吧。”

个子较矮的收尾人压低了声音，但她的话字字尖锐地刺向那名保险职员。

“我只是这里的员工。我必须按照你们保单的条款办事。”

“那就照着办啊。有什么问题？你真的很让人火大。”

……看来是保险理赔方面起了纠纷。

我们该怎么做？
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971125#d.en:
At a counter tucked into an alley, two Fixers of markedly different heights are arguing with a clerk.

"It was a clean cut, you know. We retrieved the head after the whole situation was taken care of."

"My dear fellow, do you truly think we'd pay for such expensive stasis-preservation packaging just to commit insurance fraud?"

"According to the policy, you'll need to go back and recover the torso too before we can help—"

"Oh, c'mon. You can't be serious."

The shorter Fixer keeps her voice low, but her words cut sharply into the insurance clerk.

"I'm only an employee here. I have to follow the terms of your insurance policy."

"Then follow them. What's the problem? You're really getting on my nerves."

... It seems there's a dispute over an insurance claim.

How should we proceed?

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971125#o.zh:
“如果没办法证明的话，就只能按合同条款来了……”

“这种事在都市里可是天天都有的。”

“你是说我们是骗子？你真的把我惹毛了。”

就在那名个子较小的收尾人开始把长枪转向我们时……

“恕我直言，小姐，若您继续这般行事，我们将别无选择，只能强行请您离开。”

一名看起来像是主管的职员走上前来，手里握着一根尖头手杖。

“我们回去吧。……只能另找一具合适的义体了。”

“该死的保险公司。总是这一套破事。”

“下次请仔细阅读您的保单。”

两名收尾人拿着他们的停滞保存箱离开了。

“刚才差几分钟就要闹得很难看了。话说，各位自己有保险吗？我们有一款正适合这类纠纷的保单。不如听我说说？光是咨询就能获得免费赠品哦！首先，这个方案的第一点是……”

为了摆脱那名职员的推销，我们花掉的时间远超预期。

浪费了这么多时间，我们得到的只有一份小小的促销赠品。
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971125#o.en:
"If there's no way to prove it, you have to go by the terms of the contract..."

"These kinds of things happen all the time in the City, you know."

"Are you calling us scammers? You're really pissing me off."

Just as the smaller Fixer starts to turn her spear toward us...

"With all due respect, Miss, persist with this conduct, and we'll have no choice but to remove you by force."

An employee who looks like a supervisor steps forward, holding a sharp-tipped cane.

"Let us return. ... We'll have to find a suitable prosthetic body instead."

"Damn insurance companies. Always the same crap."

"Next time, do read your policy carefully."

The two Fixers take their stasis-preservation case and leave.

"That was minutes away from becoming really nasty. Say, do you have insurance yourselves? We have a policy that's perfect for disputes like this. Why not hear me out? You'll even get a free gift just for the consultation! Now, the first thing about this plan is..."

It takes us more time than we were willing to spare to escape the clerk's sales pitch.

All we have to show for the time we've lost is a small promotional gift.

_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971125#o.zh:
“嗯……这里有一条特别条款……”

“特别条款……？在哪儿？”

我们仔细看了看收尾人手里的保险文件。

一行细小得几乎透明的字写着一条附加条款：首次理赔无论原因均予以赔付。

“……我不记得同意过这个……”

“我早就说过签字前要仔细看了。”

“……随便了。这对我们有利。总之，这就能赔了，对吧？”

“……该死，这是第一代保单吧？因为条款太不利，我们在发售第二天就修订了……行吧，在这儿等着。我们会按条款为你们办理理赔。”

保险职员气恼地把文件揉成一团，嘟嘟囔囔地退回了里面。

“谢了。你们眼睛挺尖的。”

“我们现在也没什么别的能给你们的……拿着，这个给你们。”

“虽然坏了，但材料很贵。拿去好一点的工坊应该能卖个不错的价钱。”

过了一会儿，两名收尾人拿起他们的停滞保存箱，在职员的指引下走了进去。
_tail/ActionEvents-walpu10.json#971125#o.en:
"Hm... There's a special clause here..."

"A special clause...? Where?"

We take a closer look at the insurance papers the Fixers are holding.

In tiny, almost transparent print, a rider states that the first claim is covered regardless of the cause.

"... I don't remember agreeing to that..."

"I did tell you to read things carefully before signing."

"... Whatever. This works out for us. Anyway, so it's covered, right?"

"... Dammit, that's the first-generation policy, isn't it? We revised it the day after release because the terms were so unfavorable... Fine, wait here. We'll process your claim as written."

The insurance clerk crumples the paperwork in frustration and retreats inside, grumbling.

"Thanks. Sharp eyes you've got."

"We don't really have anything else to give you right now... Here, take this."

"It's damaged, but the material is expensive. A good Workshop should pay a decent sum for it."

A little later, the two Fixers pick up their stasis-preservation case and head inside at the clerk's direction.

_tailmech/Bufs-walpu10.json#DawnOfficeSt.zh:
棺中被加热过的蝴蝶们如同扑击般飞出，将攻击对象熔化并撕裂。

“菲利普，这类武器对你而言还太早了，不过至少了解一下它的用法也没坏处。”

“棺中的多把刀刃，能让人轻松得多地同时应对多名对手。这样一来，就连通常一名收尾人难以独自处理的委托也能接下了。”
_tailmech/Bufs-walpu10.json#DawnOfficeSt.en:
Heated to a smoldering temperature within the coffin are butterflies, the kaleidoscope spilling forth to melt and tear the target apart.

"This type of weapon is still too premature for you to wield, Philip, but it shouldn't hurt to at least learn how it works."

"All those blades inside the coffin make it much easier to deal with multiple opponents at once. That way, you can even take on jobs that would normally be too much for a single Fixer to handle."

_tailmech/Passives.json#1111601#flavor.zh:
单靠打磨枪头，所能获得的穿透力终究有限。以专利合金或从废墟中回收的稀有材料锻造的长枪或许能带来更好的效果，但其价格足以抵得上一间普通收尾人事务所数年的预算。更为经济的做法，是驾驭周围的气流，使之缠绕于武器之上，以低廉得多的成本赋予其可怕的穿透力。这门技术早已成熟，许多工坊都推出了各自的实现方式。
楔子事务所的长枪便出自这样一间工坊之手。再配合该事务所独树一帜、将扭转与旋转运用得炉火纯青的枪术，这些武器已贯穿了数不清的敌人。
_tailmech/Passives.json#1111601#flavor.en:
There is only so much piercing power to be gained from sharpening a spearhead. Spears forged from Patented alloys or rare materials recovered from the Ruins may offer greater results, but their price can rival several years' worth of an ordinary Fixer Office's budget. A far more economical approach is to harness the surrounding currents of wind and coil them around the weapon, granting it formidable piercing power at a fraction of the cost. The technique is well-established, with many Workshops offering their own implementations.
Wedge Office's spears are the handiwork of one such Workshop. Combined with the Office's distinctive spearwork, which makes masterful use of twisting and rotational movements, these weapons have run countless foes through.

_tailmech/Passives.json#1111602#desc.zh:

- 回合结束时，使自身恢复50%的体力
- 本场战斗中，受到的伤害-20%
_tailmech/Passives.json#1111602#desc.en:

_tailmech/Passives.json#1111604#flavor.zh:
大多数收尾人事务所都会通过合作来弥补彼此的不足。

然而，也有一些事务所彼此间默契得天衣无缝，以至于这份合作关系逐渐升华为更深的羁绊。随着互通情报、建立起更深的信任，它们最终甚至可能将彼此视作手足。
_tailmech/Passives.json#1111604#flavor.en:
Most Fixer Offices work together to make up for one another's shortcomings.

Some Offices, however, find themselves so perfectly in sync that their partnership grows into something more. As they exchange information and forge deeper bonds of trust, they may eventually come to regard one another as siblings.

_tailmech/Passives.json#1031601#flavor.zh:
都市的街道一旦入夜，便从不缺少卑劣而野蛮的家伙。急于翻身的老鼠、怀揣复仇之梦的后巷居民、为利益明争暗斗的帮派与指头……当然，还有清道夫。

尽管日落之后的工作能赚得盆满钵满，愿意接下这类委托的收尾人却寥寥无几。然而，总有人恰恰能在他人不敢涉足之处找到最好的机会。

能以惊人的精准洞察任何局势的眼力；能干净利落、不留后患地了结工作的迅速与周全。凭借这两项最大的长处，楔子事务所挺过了每一份委托，并带走了随之而来的丰厚报酬。
_tailmech/Passives.json#1031601#flavor.en:
The streets of the City are never short of vile and savage company after dark. Rats desperate to turn their lives around, denizens of the Backstreets harboring dreams of revenge, Syndicates and Fingers embroiled in struggles over their interests... and, of course, the Sweepers.

For all the fortunes to be made from working after sundown, few Fixers are eager to accept such contracts. There are, however, those who find their greatest opportunities precisely where others dare not tread.

The discernment to read any situation with remarkable precision. The swiftness and thoroughness to bring a job to its conclusion without inviting further trouble. With these two qualities as its greatest assets, Wedge Office has weathered every contract and walked away with the handsome compensation that follows.

_tailmech/Passives.json#1101711#flavor.zh:
都市的街道一旦入夜，便从不缺少卑劣而野蛮的家伙。急于翻身的老鼠、怀揣复仇之梦的后巷居民、为利益明争暗斗的帮派与指头……当然，还有清道夫。

尽管日落之后的工作能赚得盆满钵满，愿意接下这类委托的收尾人却寥寥无几。然而，总有人恰恰能在他人不敢涉足之处找到最好的机会。

能以惊人的精准洞察任何局势的眼力；能干净利落、不留后患地了结工作的迅速与周全。凭借这两项最大的长处，楔子事务所挺过了每一份委托，并带走了随之而来的丰厚报酬。
_tailmech/Passives.json#1101711#flavor.en:
The streets of the City are never short of vile and savage company after dark. Rats desperate to turn their lives around, denizens of the Backstreets harboring dreams of revenge, Syndicates and Fingers embroiled in struggles over their interests... and, of course, the Sweepers.

For all the fortunes to be made from working after sundown, few Fixers are eager to accept such contracts. There are, however, those who find their greatest opportunities precisely where others dare not tread.

The discernment to read any situation with remarkable precision. The swiftness and thoroughness to bring a job to its conclusion without inviting further trouble. With these two qualities as its greatest assets, Wedge Office has weathered every contract and walked away with the handsome compensation that follows.

_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.zh: A+级的工坊武器。从成为收尾人后的第一次工作起，到烟霾战争以及那之后，这把剑一直在黎明时分的收尾人手中挥舞着。随着黎明时分的收尾人的业绩不断积累，烙印工坊的名声也随之水涨船高。作为回报，烙印工坊曾一次又一次地为他改良这把剑。正如他一路不断积攒的资历一般，这把剑也被不断地锻造和改进。 因而其曾一度被评级为S级武器，但随着黎明时分的收尾人从一线退下，开始教导下一代，晨炎的热度也不可避免地逐渐冷却，其剑刃的锋芒也慢慢变钝。
_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.en: An A+ class Workshop weapon that has remained a constant companion of its wielder, the Fixer at the Crack of Dawn, since his first days as a Fixer through the Smoke War and its fallout. Every contract successfully carried out by the Fixer added to Stigma Workshop's fame, and as a show of gratitude, they repeatedly upgraded and expanded the weapon's capabilities. Just as the Fixer's seasoned renown was built up over time, this blade, too, was forged, remade, and sharpened by the years. Morgenfeuer, once regarded as an S-class weapon, inevitably lost its fervor and edge in the twilight years of the Fixer at the Crack of Dawn as he withdrew from the front lines of the Fixer business in favor of teaching the next generation.

_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.zh:
使用这种外观上像是行李箱或是乐器盒的武器的缘由十分明确。

其一，是为了能够融入日常。在战斗中难以运用、构造复杂的武器，反而会因为其低效性而很可能不被认出是武器。

其二，是其行李箱的外形本身所带来的储物能力。因而，具有内部能够收纳物品外形的武器被Девять协会广泛使用。

不过，在这些优点之外，其在使用工坊装备的人们之间的风评却不是很好。若把掌握这把武器所花的时间投入到其他武器上的话，应该能变得更强；这是那些只会耍帅的收尾人才会使用的装备……经常能听到“如今的收尾人啊”“华而不实”这样的论断。

当遇到持有这种难以运用的装备的人时，如果其身为高阶收尾人，或是身居高位的帮派成员……这一点反而会具有别样的意义。因此，在工坊中，这类装备的名称并不叫“箱子”或“盒子”，而是被称之为“棺”。而棺中，向来会有蝴蝶相随。
_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.en:
The appeal of a weapon shaped like a suitcase or a musical instrument case is clear enough.

First, the user may blend into the cover of daily life without raising alarm. Though arms of this sort are unwieldy and complicated to make use of in battle, that perceived shortcoming makes them less likely to be recognized as tools of killing.

Secondly, weapons fashioned into the form of a case afford storage capacity. Container-shaped arms, for example, are actively used by the Fixers of the Devyat' Association.

Such convenience, however, does not automatically win favors from those who elect Workshop gear as their weapon of choice. The common opinion is that anyone who invests so much time in mastering this sort of weaponry would be better served by training with something else—in fact, the user would often hear snide remarks from other combatants, ranging from "Fixers these days" to "showy and pretentious."

But should one let this reputation for impracticality drop one's guard when facing an opponent armed with such a finicky piece of equipment, especially if they happen to be a high-ranking Fixer or a Syndicate officer, one will find that the laughable "containers" or "cases" carry quite a different weight—a weight grave enough for any Workshop worth its name to call them "coffins." And coffins, as a matter of fact, have a way of inviting butterflies.

_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.zh:
大多数收尾人事务所都会通过合作来弥补彼此的不足。

然而，也有一些事务所彼此间默契得天衣无缝，以至于这份合作关系逐渐升华为更深的羁绊。随着互通情报、建立起更深的信任，它们最终甚至可能将彼此视作手足。
_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.en:
Most Fixer Offices work together to make up for one another's shortcomings.

Some Offices, however, find themselves so perfectly in sync that their partnership grows into something more. As they exchange information and forge deeper bonds of trust, they may eventually come to regard one another as siblings.

_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.zh: 楔子式枪术
_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.en: Wedge-style Spearmanship

_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.zh:
单靠打磨枪头，所能获得的穿透力终究有限。以专利合金或从废墟中回收的稀有材料锻造的长枪或许能带来更好的效果，但其价格足以抵得上一间普通收尾人事务所数年的预算。更为经济的做法，是驾驭周围的气流，使之缠绕于武器之上，以低廉得多的成本赋予其可怕的穿透力。这门技术早已成熟，许多工坊都推出了各自的实现方式。

楔子事务所的长枪便出自这样一间工坊之手。再配合该事务所独树一帜、将扭转与旋转运用得炉火纯青的枪术，这些武器已贯穿了数不清的敌人。
_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.en:
There is only so much piercing power to be gained from sharpening a spearhead. Spears forged from Patented alloys or rare materials recovered from the Ruins may offer greater results, but their price can rival several years' worth of an ordinary Fixer Office's budget. A far more economical approach is to harness the surrounding currents of wind and coil them around the weapon, granting it formidable piercing power at a fraction of the cost. The technique is well-established, with many Workshops offering their own implementations.

Wedge Office's spears are the handiwork of one such Workshop. Combined with the Office's distinctive spearwork, which makes masterful use of twisting and rotational movements, these weapons have run countless foes through.

_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.en: Hunters of the City

_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.zh:
都市的街道一旦入夜，便从不缺少卑劣而野蛮的家伙。急于翻身的老鼠、怀揣复仇之梦的后巷居民、为利益明争暗斗的帮派与指头……当然，还有清道夫。

尽管日落之后的工作能赚得盆满钵满，愿意接下这类委托的收尾人却寥寥无几。然而，总有人恰恰能在他人不敢涉足之处找到最好的机会。

能以惊人的精准洞察任何局势的眼力；能干净利落、不留后患地了结工作的迅速与周全。凭借这两项最大的长处，楔子事务所挺过了每一份委托，并带走了随之而来的丰厚报酬。
_tailmech/Passives_Abnormality-walpu10.j.en:
The streets of the City are never short of vile and savage company after dark. Rats desperate to turn their lives around, denizens of the Backstreets harboring dreams of revenge, Syndicates and Fingers embroiled in struggles over their interests... and, of course, the Sweepers.

For all the fortunes to be made from working after sundown, few Fixers are eager to accept such contracts. There are, however, those who find their greatest opportunities precisely where others dare not tread.

The discernment to read any situation with remarkable precision. The swiftness and thoroughness to bring a job to its conclusion without inviting further trouble. With these two qualities as its greatest assets, Wedge Office has weathered every contract and walked away with the handsome compensation that follows.
